description_html:
📍 Localisation : Nantes (Île de Nantes)
🕒 Date de prise de poste : janvier 2027
🌍 Langues : français courant (> C1) et anglais professionnel (> B2)
🏡 2 jours de télétravail par semaine

🤓 Lengow, une plateforme e-commerce intelligente et automatisée

Lengow est un acteur de référence des solutions e-commerce intelligentes qui permettent aux marques et aux retailers de générer une croissance rentable.

Grâce à une suite complète de solutions SaaS combinant gestion de flux produits, gestion des marketplaces, veille tarifaire concurrentielle et monitoring des réseaux de distribution, Lengow permet aux marques et aux retailers d’accroître la visibilité de leurs produits, d’affiner leur stratégie tarifaire, de développer leurs ventes sur les marketplaces et de mieux piloter leur réseau de distribution.

Depuis 2009, Lengow accompagne plus de 3 600 marques et revendeurs dans plus de 70 pays.

Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi évoluer dans un environnement international et multiculturel, au contact d’équipes aux profils variés, réparties notamment entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

À propos de l’équipe IT interne

L’équipe IT interne de Lengow veille au bon fonctionnement et à la sécurité de l’environnement de travail de nos 150 collaborateurs répartis entre Nantes, Paris et Barcelone.

Elle est composée d’un(e) IT Manager, responsable de l’ensemble du périmètre IT interne, accompagné(e) d’un(e) alternant(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux.

Notre environnement couvre notamment le support utilisateurs, la gestion du parc informatique, les systèmes et réseaux, la gestion des comptes et des accès, la sécurité et l’administration de nos outils internes.

L’équipe intervient dans un environnement multi-sites et multi-OS (Windows, macOS et Linux) et travaille à la fois sur les opérations IT du quotidien et sur des projets d’amélioration et de modernisation de notre environnement.

Objectif du poste

Nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Systèmes et Réseaux en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe IT et travailler au quotidien aux côtés de l’IT Manager.

Cette alternance te permettra de développer une expérience concrète et polyvalente de l’IT interne, aux côtés de l’IT Manager. Tu monteras progressivement en compétences sur un périmètre IT varié, avec de plus en plus d’autonomie et de responsabilités, aussi bien sur les opérations du quotidien que sur des projets d’amélioration. 

Tu évolueras dans un environnement international, avec des collaborateurs présents sur plusieurs sites, à accompagner aussi bien sur place qu’à distance.

⌨️ Tes principales missions

Support utilisateurs

  • Assurer le support IT des collaborateurs sur site et à distance
  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents liés aux postes, outils et accès
  • Préparer et accompagner les arrivées et départs des collaborateurs
  • Escalader les problématiques complexes à l’IT Manager lorsque nécessaire

Parc informatique

  • Préparer, configurer et maintenir les équipements utilisateurs
  • Participer au suivi du parc et à la gestion de l’inventaire IT
  • Intervenir sur des environnements Windows, macOS et Linux
  • Participer au renouvellement et au déploiement des équipements

Systèmes, accès & réseaux

  • Participer à l’administration de Google Workspace et Active Directory
  • Contribuer à la gestion des comptes, groupes et droits utilisateurs
  • Participer au maintien et au dépannage du réseau : Wi-Fi, VLAN, switches et connectivité
  • Contribuer au maintien en condition opérationnelle de l’environnement IT

Sécurité & amélioration continue

  • Contribuer au déploiement des mises à jour et outils de sécurité
  • Participer au suivi de la sécurité des postes de travail
  • Contribuer à la documentation des procédures et de l’environnement IT
  • Participer à l’amélioration et à l’automatisation des processus IT
  • Accompagner l’IT Manager sur différents projets d’évolution de l’environnement

Requirements

🏹 Profil recherché

Connaissances :

  • Bases solides en réseau (TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLAN)
  • Connaissances initiales en administration de systèmes Windows et/ou Linux ; une première exposition à Active Directory est appréciée
  • Sensibilisation aux bonnes pratiques de sécurité informatique
  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais professionnel (B2 minimum)

Qualités personnelles :

  • Curiosité, rigueur et envie d’apprendre
  • Bon relationnel et sens du service
  • Bonnes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes
  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à collaborer

Une première expérience en support ou administration systèmes et réseaux est appréciée, mais nous recherchons avant tout une personne avec de bonnes bases techniques et l’envie de progresser sur un périmètre IT varié.

🪜 Processus de recrutement :

  • Entretien RH en visio
  • Entretien manager
  • Test technique suivi d’un débrief

Benefits

✨ Rejoindre Lengow, c’est aussi bénéficier de nombreux avantages :

🏖️ 5 semaines de congés payés
🏡 Horaires flexibles, 2 jours de télétravail par semaine et indemnité télétravail
🍴 Tickets restaurant (EdenRed) : 8 €/jour, pris en charge à 50 % par Lengow
🚲 Indemnité mobilité douce jusqu’à 200 €/an ou remboursement des transports en commun à 50 %
💻 Choix de ton environnement de travail : MacOS, Windows ou Linux
🩺 Mutuelle & prévoyance Malakoff Humanis
🍎 Fruits frais livrés au bureau chaque semaine
🎉 Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour se retrouver et partager des moments ensemble

AWS Data Engineer

Location: London

Type : 3 days per week onsite hybrid mode

Job Overview

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, testing, improving, and maintaining new and existing databases to help users retrieve data effectively. Understanding of data privacy and governance.

  • Eigenverantwortung ab dem ersten Tag: Du führst dein Portfolio, triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und wächst mit steigender Erfahrung in Verhandlungs- und Vertragsverantwortung hinein

    Unbefristete Festanstellung, moderne Arbeitsausstattung und ein Team mit Open-Mindset

title: Commercial Terrain - Indépendant (Freelance)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at SumUp
description_html:
Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp

Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille.

La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni.

Votre rémunération

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;
  • 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois.

Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois.Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti.

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: VP, Research
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Odysseyml
description_html:
Who we are

Odyssey is an AI lab pioneering general world models: causal, multimodal systems that learn to predict and interact with the world over long horizons. This foundational technology promises to revolutionize robotics, science, healthcare, education, gaming, defense, and beyond.

Odyssey’s founders previously pioneered the most complex application of physical AI: self-driving cars. They’ve now brought together a world-class research team from DeepMind, Tesla, Waymo, Meta, Apple, and Wayve, who have made significant contributions to language models (DeepMind Gemini), video models (DeepMind Veo), world models (Wayve GAIA), and autonomous systems (Tesla FSD).

Odyssey has raised significant venture capital from GV, Amazon, AMD, EQT, NVIDIA, Natural Capital, In-Q-Tel, Elad Gil, Jeff Dean, Guillermo Rauch, Garry Tan, Kyle Vogt, and researchers from OpenAI, DeepMind, MSL, Recursive, and Thinking Machines.

What we're looking for

Odyssey is hiring a VP of Research to lead and grow our Frontier Research group, the researchers working at the cutting edge of world model capability, responsible for the first proof points of new algorithms and for pushing the frontier of what world models can do. This is a role for someone who wants to both set the research agenda and stay close enough to shape it directly, not manage from a distance.You'll report directly to Jeff Hawke, our Co-Founder and CTO, and work alongside Odyssey’s leaders.

What you'll do

  • Leading and growing the Frontier Research group, hiring, mentoring, and developing researchers at every level.

  • Owning and driving Odyssey's research agenda across world simulation, multimodality, robotics, and multi-agent learning.

  • Defining and communicating a research vision ambitious enough to position Odyssey as the leading voice in world models, one that attracts top talent to the field and to us specifically.

  • Setting the research roadmap and publication strategy, and representing Odyssey's research externally to the broader community.

  • Collaboration across disciplines with other VP-level leaders, driving forward Odyssey’s holistic top-level strategy.

Who you are

  • 10+ years of research experience with a strong publication record at top ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, and similar).

  • Deep technical expertise in at least one of generative video models, world models, multimodal learning, reinforcement learning, or robotics.

  • A track record of leading and growing research teams, including mentoring researchers at all levels, not just senior hires.

  • Demonstrated ability to set a research vision that shapes a field and pulls talent toward it.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment; startup experience preferred.

  • Equally comfortable partnering with Foundation Models, ML Platform, and Applied AI as with your own researchers.

  • Willing to be in the office 3+ days a week, ideally full-time, based in London.

  • Genuinely motivated by Odyssey's mission to discover the GPT-3 moment for world models, not just intellectually curious about it.

title: Founding Head of Public Sector
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Cosine
description_html:
Job title: Founding Head of Public Sector

Location: London; 4 days in-office, 1 day wfh

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

___________________________________________________________________________

Cosine at a glance

Cosine is the UK's frontier AI lab for autonomous software engineering — not another coding assistant, but our own models, agent stack, eval harnesses, and product layer. We build our agent tooling entirely in-house and post-train open-source models to deliver reliable, enterprise-grade coding performance in security-critical settings.

Our offerings can be used as SaaS, deployed on VPC, on-prem or fully air-gapped. Through this flexability, we are able to service large-scale, highly regulated enterprises and industries including defence, financial service and healthcare.


We’re backed by YC and were recently selected for the UK’s sovereign AI programme. The company is at a rare stage: deep technical work, real enterprise pull, and a chance to shape how AI is deployed inside defence, banking, government, and other high-trust environments.

___________________________________________________________________________

Mission

Own Cosine’s public sector engagement and GTM motion from founder-led relationship building into a repeatable commercial engine.

The role exists to build on Cosine’s growing reputation across government, defence-adjacent bodies, public sector technology teams, and the wider UK sovereign AI ecosystem, turning senior interest into deep institutional relationships, clearly understood priorities, and qualified commercial opportunities.

This is a critical sector-building role: part enterprise sales, part partnerships, part market development, part public sector navigation, and part GTM leadership.

___________________________________________________________________________

Core responsibilities

1. Lead engagement with public sector organisations and priority accounts

  • Own Cosine’s day-to-day engagement with priority public sector organisations, including central government departments, arm’s-length bodies, regulators, public agencies, national infrastructure bodies, and public sector technology teams.

  • Build on Cosine’s growing reputation in sovereign AI, secure deployment, and trusted AI engineering to create senior routes into the right organisations.

  • Maintain a clear account map across key public sector organisations, including executive sponsors, digital and technology leaders, commercial/procurement stakeholders, policy teams, risk/security owners, and delivery teams.

  • Move relationships from broad sovereign AI interest into specific, practical areas where Cosine can create value.

2. Build multi-threaded senior relationships

  • Develop relationships across multiple departments, divisions, seniority levels, and decision-making layers in each target account.

  • Engage CIO, CTO, CISO, CDIO, digital, data, engineering, architecture, commercial, procurement, transformation, policy, security, and operational stakeholders.

  • Identify how priorities differ across teams, for example secure AI deployment, software assurance, legacy modernisation, operational resilience, cost reduction, productivity, national capability, procurement risk, and governance.

  • Build enough trust that Cosine becomes part of the strategic conversation around sovereign AI adoption, not just another vendor responding to tenders.

3. Build Cosine’s understanding of public sector sovereign AI priorities

  • Run structured discovery across public sector organisations to understand what they truly care about in sovereign AI.

  • Capture use cases, constraints, buying triggers, objections, governance requirements, security expectations, procurement routes, deployment models, and success metrics.

  • Translate public sector customer signal into internal intelligence for sales, partnerships, product, research, engineering, marketing, and leadership.

  • Build a sector view of where Cosine has the strongest right to win, including priority use cases, highest-intent accounts, likely buyer personas, procurement routes, SI influence, and repeatable commercial narratives.

Priority areas to explore include:

  • Secure AI coding and software engineering inside sensitive or regulated public sector environments.

  • AI adoption where source code, credentials, data, or infrastructure cannot leave the customer’s control boundary.

  • Legacy system modernisation and maintenance.

  • Software assurance, auditability, testing, review, and governance.

  • Productivity and resilience across public sector digital delivery teams.

  • Deployment models across public cloud, customer VPC, on-prem, secure environments, and air-gapped environments where required.

  • National capability, sovereign AI, and reducing dependency on foreign-controlled AI infrastructure.

4. Build towards commercial opportunities

  • Convert reputation, relationship-building, and market education into qualified pipeline opportunities.

  • Identify where there is a real public sector problem, accountable owner, budget route, technical champion, procurement path, and reason to act now.

  • Shape opportunities into concrete next steps: workshops, technical deep-dives, discovery sessions, pilots, proof-of-concepts, deployment planning, bid participation, or commercial proposals.

  • Work with the wider GTM team to move qualified public sector opportunities through the sales cycle.

  • Keep a clear view of account status, stakeholder map, open actions, risks, next steps, procurement routes, SI involvement, and commercial likelihood.

The role should focus deeply on commercial pull: serious conversations, mapped accounts, live opportunities, pilots, bid routes, and ultimately revenue.

5. Work closely with systems integrators and delivery partners

  • Work alongside Cosine’s Head of Partnerships to build and manage relationships with the systems integrators, consultancies, and delivery partners that shape public sector buying.

  • Identify where SIs can create routes into accounts, provide bid access, support delivery credibility, or help Cosine become part of larger transformation programmes.

  • Build joint account plans with priority partners where there is a clear public sector opportunity.

  • Support bid strategy, partner positioning, framework access, and teaming discussions where Cosine is best placed as a specialist sovereign AI or secure AI engineering partner.

  • Ensure SI engagement is commercially purposeful, with clear ownership, target accounts, bid opportunities, and follow-up actions.

6. Navigate public sector routes to market

  • Build a clear view of the procurement and commercial routes that matter for Cosine in public sector.

  • Understand where Cosine should pursue direct engagement, partner-led opportunities, framework routes, innovation pathways, pilots, or inclusion in larger SI-led bids.

  • Help shape compliant engagement approaches that create trust without relying on frequent hosted events or activity that could create procurement issues.

  • Use targeted briefings, structured discovery, partner conversations, written materials, and appropriate market engagement routes to progress opportunities.

  • Work with legal, commercial, partnerships, and leadership to ensure public sector engagement is commercially useful and procurement-aware.

7. Help build the GTM team in public sector

  • Help define what the public sector GTM motion should become as Cosine scales.

  • Build the early playbook for account selection, stakeholder mapping, discovery, qualification, partner-led entry, SI engagement, bid strategy, pilot design, procurement navigation, and commercial progression.

  • Help recruit, onboard, and develop future GTM hires focused on public sector.

  • Establish the operating cadence for the sector: account reviews, pipeline tracking, partner follow-up, bid tracking, customer insight capture, and internal reporting.

  • Work closely with SDRs, partnerships, marketing, founders, enterprise sales, and the Head of Partnerships to make public sector a repeatable vertical.

___________________________________________________________________________

What good looks like in the first 6 months

  • Multi-threaded relationships established across the most important public sector accounts.

  • The three top priority public sector accounts are established, with account maps, stakeholder coverage, routes to procurement, partner/SI strategy, and business cases set out.

  • A structured view of public sector sovereign AI use cases, buyer priorities, objections, procurement routes, SI influence, and buying triggers.

  • Qualified opportunities progressing into discovery, technical deep-dives, pilots, bid discussions, partner motions, or commercial proposals.

  • Clear working rhythm with the Head of Partnerships on SI engagement, bid routes, partner mapping, and public sector account strategy.

  • A clear public sector GTM playbook that future hires can build from.

___________________________________________________________________________

Success metrics

Relationship and market development

  • Number of priority public sector accounts actively engaged.

  • Number of senior stakeholder relationships built across target accounts.

  • Number of multi-threaded accounts with executive, technical, commercial, procurement, and partner coverage.

  • Quality of customer insight captured on sovereign AI priorities, deployment requirements, procurement constraints, and use cases.

Commercial progression

  • Qualified public sector opportunities created.

  • Workshops, technical deep-dives, pilots, bid discussions, partner motions, or proposals initiated.

  • Pipeline generated or influenced.

  • Conversion of reputation and senior engagement into live commercial next steps.

  • Evidence that Cosine is becoming a serious strategic partner in target public sector accounts.

Partner and SI engagement

  • Priority SI and consultancy relationships mapped and actively managed alongside the Head of Partnerships.

  • Joint account plans created with the most relevant partners.

  • Bid opportunities, framework routes, or partner-led entry points identified.

  • Clear evidence that partner engagement is creating access, credibility, or commercial opportunity.

Team and operating system

  • Public sector account map and stakeholder tracker built and maintained.

  • Partner/SI map built and maintained with clear ownership and next steps.

  • Repeatable cadence established for account reviews, partner follow-up, bid tracking, and sector reporting.

  • Future public sector GTM hiring profile defined.

___________________________________________________________________________

Cosine’s responsibilities

Cosine will support the role with:

  • Founder access for senior meetings and strategic accounts.

  • Existing reputation, warm routes, and credibility from Cosine’s sovereign AI work.

  • Support from the Head of Partnerships on SI engagement, partner strategy, bid routes, and partner-led account entry.

  • Support from partnerships, marketing, product, engineering, ML, and legal where needed.

  • Enterprise-grade materials on sovereign AI, deployment models, security, product architecture, public sector use cases, and ROI.

  • Budget for targeted customer and partner engagement where appropriate and compliant.

  • Clear internal ownership for technical escalation, pilot scoping, legal/procurement, bid support, and product feedback.

  • A single accountable line manager for commercial direction and prioritisation.

___________________________________________________________________________

Candidate profile

This role is likely to suit someone who:

  • Has sold, partnered, or built relationships inside public sector, government, regulated infrastructure, defence-adjacent markets, or public sector technology programmes.

  • Understands how public sector organisations buy, including procurement routes, framework dynamics, bid processes, partner influence, and the role of SIs.

  • Can credibly engage senior stakeholders while still doing the account-by-account follow-up work themselves.

  • Understands complex enterprise and public sector buying cycles and knows how to move from relationship to qualified opportunity.

  • Is comfortable working with SIs, consultancies, and delivery partners without losing sight of Cosine’s own commercial interest.

  • Is procurement-aware and knows how to build trust in public sector without relying on heavy entertainment, excessive events, or informal routes that may create issues later.

  • Is comfortable with ambiguity, sector-building, and founder-led GTM rather than inheriting a mature sales machine.

  • Thinks commercially, writes clearly, and can build account plans, briefing notes, proposals, bid inputs, and internal decision materials without heavy supervision.

  • Has the judgement to know when a conversation is just interesting and when it is becoming real pipeline.

___________________________________________________________________________

Summary

The Founding Head of Public Sector should make Cosine impossible to ignore for the right public sector organisations.

They should build on Cosine’s growing reputation in sovereign AI, understand what these institutions actually need, build the relationships required to be taken seriously, and work closely with systems integrators and the Head of Partnerships to create credible routes into bids and programmes.

Over time, they should turn that trust into qualified commercial opportunities, while building the team, playbook, partner motion, procurement discipline, and operating cadence that make public sector a repeatable Cosine vertical rather than a founder-led experiment.

_____________________________________________________________________

Why join Cosine

  • Opportunity to sell a genuinely differentiated product into mission-critical defence and national security environments

  • Meaningful early equity with real upside

  • Direct impact on product direction and go-to-market strategy

  • Small, elite team with high standards and strong technical depth

  • What you can expect:

    • Competitive salary, benchmarked to the market

    • Equity / share options, so you share in the upside you help create

    • 30 days’ holiday + bank holidays

    • Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly

    • Dog-friendly office - bring your dog to work

    • Weekly team breakfast & lunch

    • Monthly socials

    • Pension

    • High-quality equipment to do your best work

_____________________________________________________________________

Equal Opportunity

We’re an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from everyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t tick every box.

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Rogo
description_html:
Why Rogo

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

title: Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Fyxer
description_html:
Lead Product Designer

 

The design philosophy

At Fyxer, design starts with human behaviour rather than with screens, components or flows. We think the best product decisions come from understanding why people do what they do, and working back from there. It isn't a principle we put on a wall. It's how we make decisions.

What you're walking into

We're not starting from zero. We have a creative designer on the team, a visual identity built with Red Antler, a design system, and a product that real users depend on every day.

What we don't have is a senior product design voice. Someone who gets the first call across the company when a product, experience or communication decision needs a human-behaviour lens on it.

That's this role. You'll report to our Head of Product and work as the sole designer, an early design hire, alongside our engineers. You'll be the most senior product design hire we've made, with real influence over what gets built and over how this company thinks about the people it builds for.

If you think understanding people is the hardest and most important part of design, and that everything else follows from that, this is the role for you.

What we care about, in order

01. Human behaviour first

You think in motivation, habit and friction before you think in screens. You understand why people do what they do, and you use that to make product decisions, not just design decisions.

02. Craft and execution

You ship. You work directly with engineers and move fast without losing the quality that makes a product feel premium.

03. AI-native workflows

You understand how modern engineers build with AI tools, and you think about design in that context. We care about principles, components and systems that plug into engineering workflows rather than sitting in static documentation. You're comfortable working close to implementation, and you help keep experiences coherent while teams move quickly with AI-assisted development.

What you'll be working on

Fyxer is an AI-powered productivity platform. You'll design interfaces where the AI does real work: raising something people missed, live transcription, deeply personalised drafts, complex cross-surface workflows. They need to feel effortless despite genuine complexity underneath.

A large part of this role is interaction design. We're building products with real complexity under the hood, and we care about making those experiences feel calm, intuitive and coherent across every touchpoint, such as:

  • A dashboard experience that makes AI feel like a natural daily habit

  • A real-time notetaker that generates live transcripts and captures the right context

  • Personalised AI draft generation that adapts to each user's communication style

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years designing in high-growth, early-stage environments where structure was something you built, not something you inherited.

  • You understand technical constraints well enough to have a real conversation with an engineer, not just hand over a Figma file.

  • You run your own user research. You talk to users, watch session recordings, and use what you find to defend or change your design decisions.

  • You move fast and use AI tools to help you. You know when to be rigorous and when to unblock someone with an MVP.

Nice to have: experience making design changes in the codebase.

The stack

  • Design: Figma, Miro, Lucide

  • Component alignment: ShadCN, Tailwind CSS, V0

  • Insight: PostHog (surveys, session recording, analytics)

Why Fyxer?

We're intentional about our team. A small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organisation.

  • Autonomy: we hire people who want ownership.

  • Velocity: you'll be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

  • Scale: a rare chance to join a high-growth rocket ship at the foundational stage.

The Fyxer reality

  • The trajectory: we grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of 32.

  • The evidence: ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz's list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We're the outlier.

  • The culture of agency: we hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero bureaucracy: no slow-motion decision-making, no alignment meetings for the sake of it.

This culture is intense. It takes focus and discipline, so we'll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing and reward your impact.

Compensation: £100K – £140K • £100K – £140K Equity

About Aptura

Aptura is building the reinforcement learning data company that powers frontier model training globally. We combine deep expertise in finance with cutting-edge in-house tech to deliver tailored, domain-specific training data and feedback loops.

At work, we're building a high-performance, people-first culture. We move quickly, think ambitiously, and set a high bar for ourselves, all while staying open, collaborative, and genuinely enjoyable to work with. The best ideas here win regardless of who they come from, teams sit close to leadership, and every voice has a say in what comes next.

The Opportunity

In this 3-month internship, you will apply your knowledge to improve AI reasoning across complex financial workflows. You will help develop, evaluate, and refine high-quality training data that enables AI models to reason more accurately about financial analysis, valuation, transactions, and investment banking use cases.

In this role you will

  • Develop realistic investment banking scenarios, prompts, and reference solutions that reflect real-world analytical workflows.

  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for financial accuracy, reasoning quality, technical rigor, and completeness using structured evaluations.

  • Collaborate with domain experts to translate finance expertise into high-quality evaluation criteria and training signals.

This role will be a great fit if you

  • 1+ years of professional experience in investment banking, private equity, equity research, transaction advisory, valuation, corporate finance, or a closely related analytical role.

  • Can critically assess financial reasoning and identify errors, unsupported assumptions, and gaps in analysis.

  • Communicate clearly and can explain why a piece of financial reasoning is correct or incorrect.

  • Tech, screens, and any equipment you need to perform at a high level

description_html:
About Aptura

We build the evaluation datasets and RL environments that make AI reliable in domains where mistakes are expensive: finance, healthcare, and legal. Our team designs expert-curated training data, calibrated rubrics, and verifiable task environments for AI labs and startups pushing the frontier of what models can do in regulated industries.

We're a small, lean, London based team that moves fast and takes the work seriously. Everyone contributes directly. Initiative is rewarded, and ownership is the default. If you want to shape how frontier AI learns to operate in the real world, we'd like to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff on our Applied AI team, you will build the tasks and environments that AI labs use to train and evaluate their agents in finance, healthcare, and legal.

Day to day, that looks like: constructing RL environments around spreadsheets, documents, and professional workflows. Writing verification logic and reward functions. Working with domain experts to scope what a correct answer actually looks like in an LBO model or a clinical note. Some days it's engineering, some days it's closer to research. The common thread is that you're producing the ground truth that frontier models get measured against.

What You'll Do

  • Build RL environments across finance, healthcare, and legal domains

  • Assist in designing tasks with golden answers, calibrated rubrics, and programmatic reward signals

  • Write verification logic and reward functions that can distinguish good model outputs from bad ones

  • Work directly with domain experts (investment analysts, physicians, attorneys) to translate complex professional workflows into structured tasks

  • Prototype new approaches to evaluation, verification, and synthetic data generation

Who We're Looking For

  • Practical experience building with LLMs: prompting, evaluation, and agentic harnesses. You've built things that actually run, not just notebooks.

  • High agency and technically sharp. You don't wait for permission, specs, or a roadmap. You see what needs doing, figure out how, and get it done.

  • Comfortable working across very different contexts. The job moves between engineering, evaluation design, and deep collaboration with domain experts often in the same day.

  • You ship and iterate. Small team, no room for work that sits in review. Bias toward getting something working, learning from it, and improving it.

  • You own problems end to end, from scoping with a domain expert through to a working environment. If you prefer clearly partitioned tickets, this probably isn't the right fit.

  • Already using LLMs as part of how you build, not just as the thing you're building for.

Nice to Have

  • Domain knowledge in finance, healthcare, or legal

  • Familiarity with RL concepts, model training, and post-training workflows

  • Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS or GCP)

  • Previous startup experience, especially as an early engineer

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and build the category-defining company in AI safety - this role is for you!


What You’ll Do

Automate low-value work out of the commercial process so the Sales team can spend more time closing deals

  • Design and build the systems that power how we find, acquire, and retain customers (both outbound and inbound)

  • Own the CRM: you make sure our data is clean, structured, and reliable

  • Build internal tools, API integrations, and custom automation logic

  • Design the GTM data model (accounts, contacts and opportunities)

  • Build and manage data pipeline, enrichment and integrations across the stack

  • Build, ship and iterate fast

What We’re Looking For

Background & Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in GTM engineering, technical RevOps, or a growth role where you were building automations and pipelines

  • Experience designing and scaling systems in a high-growth company

  • Hands-on with modern GTM tooling - Claude Code, Clay, Apollo, Instantly, n8n or similar - you've built multi-step enrichment and sequencing workflows, not just set up a table

  • Comfortable with Python or SQL well enough to work with data, call APIs, and build lightweight scoring or enrichment logic

  • Top-of-funnel focused - you know how to build systems that generate qualified pipeline at scale, from ICP definition through to booked meetings

What success looks like in the first 6 months

In your first six months, we would expect you to identify the highest-converting early segments, build a functioning outbound and follow-up engine, create clear messaging for one or two strong wedges, generate a meaningful pipeline of qualified conversations, and help convert early pilots or customers. How we hire

CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients. 

 

Why us?

🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.

🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.

🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.

🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.

💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.

CUBE is a well-established brand with a dominant presence across the world's largest financial institutions, trusted by GSIBs and leading Tier 1 banks globally. CUBE Intel is our mid-market product - purpose-built for mid-market firms that need robust regulatory change management without the complexity of an enterprise deployment. This presents a real opportunity for the right person to build a territory, bring on new logos, and make their mark. We move fast, we listen to ideas, and we back the people who bring them.

Responsibilities:

  • The new Account Executive will drive CUBE's sales efforts, and will be responsible for winning new mid-market logos across regulated businesses.

  • Lead the full sales cycle end‑to‑end, from initial engagement and qualification through to commercial negotiation and close, consistently achieving net‑new customer acquisition targets.

  • Drive new business generation through prospecting, market mapping, and targeted outreach.

  • Engage and influence senior stakeholders (including Heads of Legal & Compliance, Compliance Directors and equivalent leaders) to build a broad vision of strategic long-term partnership and value.

  • Maintain rigorous CRM and forecasting discipline, providing an accurate, evidence-based view of pipeline, deal progression and expected close dates.

  • Provide timely and accurate forecasts to the Head of Sales, on a weekly basis

  • Effective use of AI tools to drive GTM efficiency, prospecting, and territory planning.

  • Track and drive improvement in qualified-to-close conversion rates across the funnel, not just pipeline volume.

  • Contribute actively to the evolution of CUBE Intel's GTM strategy, using market and customer insights to refine targeting, messaging and sales execution.

Skills & Experience

  • You will be a hands-on sales professional with a strong new business sales background and a proven track record of selling SaaS solutions

  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with new prospects and senior stakeholders.

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles in a B2B environment.

  • A self-starter who is proactive in building their own pipeline; whilst a dedicated BDR function will support lead generation, candidates must be comfortable with independent outreach and market mapping.

Desirable

  • Experience with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC or equivalent.

  • Background in financial services, compliance, risk or regulatory technology - direct sector experience is a strong advantage but not a necessity.

Interested?

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.​

CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Onboarding consultant
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Planday From Xero
description_html:
Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As a Senior Onboarding Consultant, you will drive the success of Planday by leading new customers through a comprehensive onboarding and implementation journey tailored to their business size, operational complexity, and technical requirements.

You will own more complex and strategic onboarding engagements, bringing a high degree of autonomy, strong implementation discipline, and a consultative mindset to every customer interaction. You will combine deep product expertise with strong technical aptitude to help customers design scalable ways of working, manage change effectively, and realise value quickly.

You will play a key role in helping customers successfully implement Planday within their business, especially where workflows, stakeholder groups, system configuration, and integration requirements are more advanced. Your ability to lead technically credible conversations, guide customers through implementation decisions, and proactively manage risks will be critical to achieving strong adoption, smooth go-lives, and long-term customer success.

What you’ll do

  • Project manage end-to-end onboarding and multi-site implementation for upper mid-market and enterprise customer portfolios, with full ownership of strategic, technically complex, and high-value customer engagements.

  • Act as the primary implementation lead for customers with more advanced operational or technical requirements, including complex workflows, multi-site setups, and tailored rollout plans

  • Run high-quality discovery to understand customer goals, business processes, operational challenges, and implementation risks, and translate these into a clear onboarding plan

  • Guide customers through solution design and configuration decisions, ensuring Planday is implemented in a way that aligns with their business needs and supports long-term success

  • Lead implementation conversations with a broad range of stakeholders, including operational, commercial, technical, and executive contacts

  • Deliver a high-quality onboarding experience through a consultative, structured, and customer-centric approach

  • Proactively identify delivery risks, technical blockers, and adoption challenges, and drive them through to resolution

  • Support customers through change management and go-live planning to ensure successful launches and strong early adoption

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and smooth handover across the customer lifecycle

  • Maintain strong implementation governance, accurate CRM records, and disciplined use of internal processes, systems, and onboarding best practices

  • Use data, customer insight, and frontline experience to identify opportunities to improve onboarding playbooks, implementation processes, and customer outcomes

  • Act as a senior member of the team by sharing knowledge, raising the bar on execution, and contributing to continuous improvement across onboarding.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Proven experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role, with experience owning more complex customer engagements

  • Strong SaaS implementation experience, with the ability to lead customers through structured rollout and change processes from kickoff to go-live

  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence discussing system configuration, implementation requirements, workflow design, and integration-related considerations with customers

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, technical, and leadership audiences

  • Ability to run excellent discovery, uncover customer needs, and translate them into practical implementation plans and business outcomes

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build credibility with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Excellent project, time management, and prioritisation skills across multiple concurrent customer journeys

  • A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating with autonomy and accountability

  • Empathy, patience, and a solutions-focused mindset, paired with the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

  • Confidence using CRM systems and customer engagement tools, with strong process discipline and attention to detail

  • High professionalism, integrity, and a collaborative, low-ego approach

  • Experience in workforce-intensive industries such as hospitality, retail, healthcare, or shift-based environments is preferred

  • Experience working on technically involved implementations, including integrations, data considerations, or more complex business process design, is highly desirable

Success looks like

  • Customers successfully go live on time with strong adoption and clear alignment to their business goals

  • Complex onboarding and implementation projects are managed effectively, with risks identified early and handled proactively

  • Customers feel confident in their solution design, implementation approach, and path to value

  • Strong stakeholder relationships are built across customer teams, including more senior and technical contacts

  • High customer satisfaction, strong implementation quality, and minimal escalations

  • Consistent achievement of onboarding goals and KPIs, with strong ownership of outcomes

  • Positive contribution to team culture, capability uplift, and continuous improvement across the onboarding function

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

title: Solution Architect
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Certa
description_html:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

The Solution Architect is the primary functional lead on Certa implementations, sitting at the intersection of business consulting and technical delivery. You'll translate complex client requirements into scalable platform solutions, own the solution design from discovery through go-live, and serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders ranging from procurement leads and risk officers to CIOs and CPOs. It's a high-impact, client-facing role for an experienced consultant who combines deep domain expertise in TPRM, vendor management, or procurement with hands-on implementation skills and a passion for solving complex operational challenges through technology.

What You'll Do

  • Lead solution design & delivery: Lead end-to-end solution design for Certa implementations, translating client TPRM frameworks, risk processes, and business requirements into scalable, best-practice configurations, and own the solution blueprint and technical design documentation for each engagement.

  • Configure & integrate: Design and build workflow automation, intake forms, approval routing, risk scoring models, reporting, and integration patterns (APIs, SSO/SAML, ERPs, GRC tools, procurement systems), driving to a high-quality, on-time go-live.

  • Advise clients: Lead discovery workshops and requirements-gathering sessions across procurement, compliance, legal, IT, and risk, acting as a trusted advisor on TPRM, supplier onboarding, and procurement automation best practices, and facilitating process-mapping and gap-analysis exercises.

  • Manage the engagement: Manage client expectations proactively around scope, feasibility, and trade-offs, and produce high-quality solution documentation, configuration guides, and knowledge-transfer materials that enable long-term client self-sufficiency.

  • Mentor & build the practice: Support and mentor junior Implementation Consultants through technical guidance and design reviews, and contribute reusable accelerators, templates, and playbooks while staying current on platform releases and emerging TPRM, ESG, and procurement trends.

What You'll Need

  • Domain experience: 5+ years in TPRM, vendor/supplier management, procurement, GRC, or supply chain operations, with a solid understanding of the enterprise vendor lifecycle (onboarding, due diligence, risk assessment, contract management, off-boarding) and familiarity with frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, or DORA.

  • Implementation consulting: 3+ years of hands-on implementation consulting delivering enterprise SaaS or workflow automation (ideally TPRM, procurement, or related domains), with a proven track record leading full-cycle implementations from discovery through go-live at complex enterprise clients, across Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

  • Technical skills: Proficiency configuring no-code/low-code workflow or BPM platforms (Certa, Appian, Pega, Salesforce, or ServiceNow), working knowledge of integration patterns (REST APIs, webhooks, SSO/SAML, data import/export), and the ability to read JSON/XML (basic scripting or query experience a plus).

  • Landscape & tooling: Awareness of the TPRM/procurement technology landscape (Coupa, Ariba, ServiceNow, Archer, OneTrust, or comparable), and proficiency with project and documentation tooling (JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Lucidchart, or equivalents).

  • Communication & mindset: An exceptional communicator who translates technical concepts for business stakeholders and business context for technical teams, a structured analytical thinker comfortable with ambiguity, highly organized and self-directed in a fast-paced, remote-first environment, with a client-centric commitment to delivering value and building long-term trusted relationships.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Compensation: Top of market salary + bonuses and equity

  • Time off: 49 days paid time off

  • Benefits: PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

  • Growth: Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

  • Team building: Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

Location

Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

  • London

  • San Francisco

  • Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

Why Certa

  • Category leadership. Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools - recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

  • Industry recognition. We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

  • A top place to work. Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

  • Real scale with strong backing. We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

title: Initiative Application

description_html:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

Don't see a role that fits? Apply here anyway. We grow fast, and new openings appear all the time - often before they're posted. If you're excited about Certa and believe you can make an impact, this is your front door. Tell us what you're great at and where you think you'd add value, and the right team will reach out when there's a match.

What You'll Do

  • Tell us your story: Share what you do best, the kind of work that energizes you, and the problems you want to solve - in your own words, not a generic cover letter.

  • Point us to the fit: Let us know which teams or types of roles interest you (engineering, product, customer, go-to-market, operations, or something else) so we can route your application to the right people.

  • Show your impact: Highlight the work you're proudest of - a project you shipped, a problem you cracked, a function you built - and the difference it made.

What You'll Need

  • A clear strength: A track record of doing excellent work in your field, whatever that field is.

  • Ownership & curiosity: You take initiative, dig into how things actually work, and act on problems before they escalate - exactly the kind of person who applies before a role is even posted.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built.

title: Founding Product Designer
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Adclear
description_html:
Founding Product Designer

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. The product you'll design is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we've already earned the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise 2.6m in funding, and we're now scaling fast. We're building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Basics

Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

Reports to: founders, working day to day alongside our CTO

The role: our first dedicated designer, owning the product experience end to end

The Role

You'd be the first designer at Adclear. Today, design here is developer-led and largely AI/vibe-coded, with no single owner. That's the gap you're filling: the product's look, feel and flow are yours to mold, and the design function is yours to build from the ground up.

This role has two distinct halves, and we're looking for someone who can genuinely do both.

The first is improving what already exists. Adclear is a live product used regularly by enterprises and other customers. You'll bring coherence to the UI, refine and properly apply our existing design system across the app, improve existing functionality, and design complex new features on top of it. Strong UX judgment matters as much as UI polish here: a lot of this is making genuinely complex, regulated workflows navigable for non-technical users like compliance reviewers and marketers.

The second is zero-to-one. We'll likely be building two new product lines from scratch alongside the core product, which means heavy discovery, lots of proof-of-concepts, and rapid iteration through quick mockups, AI-assisted prototypes and user testing. You'll be speaking with customers regularly across both workstreams, not just the new ones.

You won't be handed tidy specs and asked to make them pretty. You'll sit in the messy middle: talking to compliance teams and marketers at banks and fintechs, working out what they actually need, and turning genuinely hard, ambiguous problems into a product that feels obvious once it exists.

This is a design role with a real product management edge. You'll work in tandem with our CTO to shape what we build and why, not just how it looks. You'll help set priorities, scope releases and make the calls that move the roadmap.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end product experience: from problem definition and research through to interaction design, high-fidelity UI and shipped product

  • Bring consistency to the existing product: refine and coherently apply our design system across the app, and raise the UX and UI bar on what's already live

  • Work directly with our CTO to shape the roadmap, scope releases and decide what's worth building, wearing a product manager hat alongside your design one

  • Lead discovery and build proof-of-concepts for new product lines, moving from sketch to something real fast rather than over weeks

  • Run your own research: get on customer calls across both the existing product and new lines, sit in on compliance reviews, and turn what you hear into clear product direction

  • Establish the foundations of design at Adclear: the design system, the patterns, the craft bar and the way design works with engineering and go-to-market

  • Set up design process from scratch, and help build the design team over time, with the potential to lead it

  • Partner with engineering from design through implementation, staying close as things get built so the shipped product matches the intent

What you should have

  • A track record that spans early-stage chaos and later-stage scaling: you joined a company at pre-seed or seed and helped take it through to Series B, or joined at Series A and scaled it through to Series C or D. You may have covered these stages across different companies rather than one.

  • Genuine range: you're comfortable being dropped into zero-to-one ambiguity, but you've also proven you can take a product to its next level, not only start things from a blank page.

  • You've shipped code, understand how systems work under the hood, and don't need engineering to explain why something is hard

  • Prototypes in code as a default, not a last resort - You are a Figma expert and Cursor, Claude Code, or similar are already part of how you work

  • High agency: comfortable operating as the sole designer under pressure, managing a heavy and varied workload, moving quickly without sacrificing quality

What we hope you have

  • Exposure to fintech, regtech or another regulated space. A real plus, but not a must.

  • Experience designing for non-technical operators. You've built for people who use software to get a job done, like compliance reviewers and marketers, not power users who live in the tool.

  • Fluency moving between fidelities fast. Napkin sketch to clickable prototype in a day, because the fastest way to settle a debate is to make the thing real.

  • Experience building or leading a design function, or a clear point of view on how you'd start building one here.

How we work

  • Founders and the CTO are closely involved in the day-to-day, and design has a real seat at the table

  • Design drives product direction here; it doesn't decorate decisions made elsewhere

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built, and you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula and a full team handed to you on day one

Benefits

  • Competitive pay

  • Meaningful equity as our founding designer

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware and software budget so you have the tools you want

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • A rare chance to define the product and the design function of a fast-growing company from scratch

How to apply

Send us a link to your portfolio together with your CV. We read every application.

Gismart is a value-driven mobile app developer with a strong presence in the Health & Wellness, Utilities, and Music app markets. We provide exciting career opportunities, a supportive workplace culture, and the chance to contribute to a team that is making a tangible impact. For more information on Gismart, visit gismart.com.

About project


At Radiotech, we believe music belongs to everyone — not just those who grew up taking lessons. As a product company inside the Gismart ecosystem, we’ve spent years building apps that make music feel approachable, fun, and deeply human. With 23 apps across iOS and Android and over 500 million downloads worldwide, our products have found their way into the hands of musicians, beginners, and curious souls across the globe. We see music as a universal language. Our job is to make sure more people can speak it.

The Creative Production Lead owns the strategic growth of the creative production function, translating company-level goals into team execution while building the people, processes, and cross-functional relationships needed to scale creative output. This role is a defined growth track toward Head of Creative Production, with scope expanding as the team and its impact on business metrics grow.

Responsibilities:

1. Strategy & Performance

  • Decompose company OKRs into actionable creative team goals and KPIs

  • Track OKR completion, creative output volume, and performance against targets

  • Report on team performance and creative impact to leadership

2. People Management

  • Full ownership of team management: hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews

  • Design and run career development paths, including promotion criteria

  • Build a team education program (skills growth, internal training, external learning)

  • Manage team capacity planning and workload distribution

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with Product, PMM, and UA teams

  • Align creative priorities with product roadmaps and UA testing needs

  • Represent creative production in cross-functional planning cycles

4. Process & Automation

  • Identify and drive automation opportunities across the creative production pipeline (briefing, asset delivery, QA, reporting)

  • Own tooling decisions and process documentation

  • Continuously reduce time-to-launch for creative assets

5. Team Culture & Knowledge Sharing

  • Establish and run team rituals (standups, retros, creative reviews)

  • Drive in-house knowledge sharing (playbooks, best-practice libraries, post-mortems)

  • Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement

Experience:

  • 4+ years in creative production, creative strategy, or performance creative roles, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or management capacity

  • Proven track record producing creative for performance marketing channels (Meta, AppLovin, TikTok, or similar)

  • Experience with mobile app or gaming creative production is a strong plus; familiarity with playable ads (e.g. Cocos Creator or similar engines) is a bonus

  • Experience managing creative production budgets and resourcing (in-house team, freelancers, or agencies)

Mindset:

  • Systems thinker — genuinely energized by building process and automation, not just managing output

  • Growth-oriented, with clear interest in scaling into a Head of Creative Production role

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iteration-heavy environment (multiple products, frequent creative testing cycles)

Employee Benefits:

  • Remote-First Culture: Our team is diverse and extensive, just like our product portfolio. We provide a flexible working schedule and let you work anywhere in the world, either remotely or in one of our corporate hubs

  • Сoworking Compensation: We provide 100% compensation for coworking spaces in Ukraine (except Kyiv, where we have a cozy and autonomous hub) and 50% compensation for coworking spaces worldwide to make sure that everyone has a comfortable and inspiring workspace

  • Free Office Lunches: We want you to stay fueled and focused, so we provide delicious free lunches for everyone working from our hubs. It’s one less thing for you to worry about during a productive workday

  • Public Holidays Policy: Gismart observes public holidays based on the Ukrainian or Polish holiday calendars. Employees working in other locations are entitled to 12 public holidays per year

  • 100% Sick Leave Compensation

  • Mental and Physical Health: To help you stay happy and healthy, Gismart will partially cover your medical insurance, sports activities, therapy costs

  • Personal Equipment Policy: Of course, we’ll provide you with all the equipment you need or cover the maintenance cost for your own tools

  • Personal Learning and Development: We love to see you learn and grow, so Gismart will cover 70% of your professional development courses. We’ll also pay for 100% of corporate English courses

  • Time-Off Policy: Every employee gets 18 working days of paid vacation and 3 personal days per year, with an extra day added for each year at Gismart

  • Corporate Events: We are remote-first, but we love meeting up in person. Whenever possible, we organize corporate events and team-building activities across all Gismart hubs

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

THE ROLE

──────────────────────────────

XYZ Reality is developing the next generation of wearable augmented reality products for the construction industry — helmet-mounted systems that must perform reliably in some of the most demanding industrial environments in the world.

We are looking for a talented Mechanical Engineer to join our Hardware team and take a hands-on role in designing, certifying, and delivering these products. Working closely with our Senior Mechanical Engineer and a multidisciplinary R&D team, you'll be involved across the full product development cycle — from concept and prototyping through certification, manufacturing readiness, and production transition.

This is a role for someone who is practical, detail-oriented, and passionate about building innovative physical products — someone who takes ownership, gets into the workshop as readily as they get into CAD, and wants to see their engineering make a real-world difference.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

──────────────────────────────

• Design and develop helmet-mounted AR systems and accessories using SolidWorks — producing 3D models, assemblies, engineering drawings, and full production documentation to a high standard.

• Support ANSI Type II and EN397 certification programmes — designing for compliance from the outset, coordinating with certification bodies and testing laboratories, and supporting environmental, drop, impact, vibration, and ingress testing activities.

• Integrate sensor systems, batteries, antennas, optics, cameras, and electronics into compact wearable platforms — with attention to thermal management, electronics packaging, and wearable ergonomics throughout.

• Lead and support DFM and DFA activities — ensuring designs are manufacturable at scale, generating assembly instructions and engineering change documentation, and supporting production introduction and manufacturing transition.

• Work with external suppliers, contract manufacturers, and certification laboratories — managing relationships, reviewing outputs, and ensuring components and systems meet design intent and regulatory requirements.

• Collaborate closely with Hardware, Embedded, Production, Software, and R&D teams — participating in concept generation, design reviews, prototyping, and validation activities across the full development programme.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

──────────────────────────────

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering, or a related discipline, with 3–5 years of product development experience from concept through prototype and into production.

• Strong SolidWorks CAD experience — including 3D modelling, assemblies, engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation — with a solid grasp of tolerance analysis, material selection, and mechanical design principles.

• Practical, hands-on prototyping and workshop skills, with experience working across manufacturing processes including injection moulding, machining, sheet metal fabrication, and additive manufacturing.

• Experience working with external suppliers and manufacturers, and comfortable operating within a fast-paced, multidisciplinary engineering team. Familiarity with PPE, wearable products, or certification standards (ANSI, EN397, CE, UKCA) is a strong advantage.

KEY EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

──────────────────────────────

• SolidWorks CAD — 3D design, assemblies & engineering drawings

• ANSI Type II / EN397 certification & regulatory testing

• Wearable product design — helmets, PPE & head-mounted systems

• DFM / DFA & manufacturing transition support

• Sensor, optics, battery & electronics integration into wearables

• Hands-on prototyping, practical workshop & problem-solving skills

BENEFITS

──────────────────────────────

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄 Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🏠 Hybrid working

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

💰 Employee referral scheme

🚀 Make a real-world impact of revolutionising the construction industry

description_html:
About us:

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We’re looking for a Head of Legal who will lead our legal operations, ensuring our client and vendor contracting processes align with our business strategy, evolving legal standards, and risk management requirements. To do this successfully, you'll need to understand the rapidly changing GenAI regulatory environment, expertly navigate complex contract negotiations, and position Pencil as a trusted leader in AI compliance and best practices.

Key responsibilities:

  • Negotiate and manage client contracts, including redlining Master Service Agreements (MSAs) and Pencil’s standard Terms & Conditions to ensure alignment with business objectives and risk management.

  • Oversee agreements with AI technology vendors, ensuring vendor terms effectively align back-to-back with Pencil’s client obligations.

  • Act as embedded legal counsel to product teams, reviewing new features and AI capabilities for legal and regulatory risk before launch, and advising on design decisions in real time rather than after the fact.

  • Monitor the evolving AI and data regulatory landscape (e.g., EU AI Act, GDPR, sector-specific guidance) and proactively brief product and leadership on implications, translating regulatory change into practical product and commercial strategy.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously update Pencil’s legal documentation, such as Terms & Conditions, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and Privacy Policies, keeping pace with advancements in AI technology.

  • Consult with client legal teams to clearly communicate and validate Pencil's legal and technical safety protocols, facilitating trust and compliance.

  • Create thought leadership content such as whitepapers and participate in speaking engagements about legal issues related to Generative AI in marketing.

 

Your background

  • JD, LLB or equivalent law degree, and active membership in good standing of at least one state bar.

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience as a commercial or corporate attorney, specifically within the AI space.

  • Proven experience in negotiating complex contracts with clients and technology vendors.

  • Experience handling 8-figure deal value contracts with enterprise scale clients.

  • Deep understanding of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and intellectual property law.

  • Strong ability to clearly communicate complex legal concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Previous experience in drafting industry whitepapers or speaking engagements is highly desirable.

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Average MSA/T&Cs redline-to-signature cycle time

  • % of client contracts closed without material deviation from Pencil's standard paper

  • DPAs, Privacy Policy, and T&Cs reviewed/updated on a fixed cadence

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours
