Job Summary:

Want to make an impact by innovating how top global companies build teams and adapt to the Future of Work? As an Account Executive, you’ll be responsible for driving growth by acquiring new clients, re-engaging former clients, and expanding existing high-value accounts to maximize long-term growth opportunities. Success in this role comes from your ability to strategically identify and engage potential clients, uncover their key business challenges, and align Toptal’s solutions to meet their needs. This is a full-cycle sales role, which means you will take full ownership of your pipeline, including targeting ideal clients, setting your own high-quality meetings, and driving the sales process through to close.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Drive full-cycle sales by identifying and engaging high-potential prospects, re-engaging dormant clients, and generating new opportunities through strategic outreach.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to identify opportunities, present Toptal’s value proposition, and secure new business.
  • Effectively manage the sales funnel to optimize lead progression, coordinate communication among various stakeholders, and diligently follow up on accounts to nurture leads toward conversion.
  • Ensure timely and accurate CRM documentation, while providing leadership with clear sales forecasts and pipeline insights.
  • As you become more comfortable in the role, contribute to evolving our demand generation strategy and tactics to expand pipeline growth and market reach.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
  • Learn the breadth of Toptal’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
  • Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal.
  • Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
  • Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).
  • Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
  • Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal.
  • Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
  • Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
  • Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
  • Assist with training and onboarding new Account Executives.
  • Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal’s partnership with new and existing clients.
  • Suggest, implement and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Have closed multiple net new accounts from the strategic account list, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal, our model, and how proper business development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
  • Consistently maintain a high level of success by meeting and exceeding 100% of monthly and quarterly key performance indicators and targets.
  • Establish a career path for advancement.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Minimum 2 years sales experience, including at least 1 year in a closing role.
  • Experience in B2B or SaaS sales is strongly preferred.
  • Proven success in full-cycle sales, including lead generation, prospecting, running virtual sales calls, funnel management, and closing.
  • Proficient with sales tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to evolving sales platforms.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You’re persistent in the face of setbacks, eager to understand people and problems, and motivated to go above and beyond to reach your goals.
  • You thrive with autonomy and ownership. We’re looking for someone who can be held accountable for leading their portion of the business.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

title: Chief Technology Officer - US-Based
description_html:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the details.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

  • Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
  • Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
  • Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
  • Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

  • Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

  • Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
  • Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
  • Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
  • Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
  • Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
  • Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
  • Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
  • Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
  • Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
  • Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

title: Founding Sales Development Representative (SDR DACH)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Vivid
description_html:
About The Role

Vivid Money is redefining how modern businesses, growing SMEs, and financial institutions manage and optimize their capital. From high-yield Interest Accounts and multi-currency infrastructure to treasury tools and team cards, we provide the modern financial platform that traditional banks make too slow and expensive.

We are expanding our business presence across Germany.

We aren’t looking for an SDR to just follow a pre-written playbook; we are looking for our Founding SDR for the DACH market. Working directly alongside our Founding Account Executive, you will be employee number one on the SDR side, responsible for building the outbound engine from scratch. Your core focus will be opening doors with SMB decision-makers (CEOs, CFOs, Finance Directors), while strategically mapping and testing outreach to adjacent personas like holding structures, PE/VC portfolio leads, and family offices.

If you want the autonomy of a founding team member, want to write the prospecting playbook, and want to establish the top-of-funnel blueprint for Vivid in Germany, this role is for you.


Your Mission

  • Build the Outbound Engine: Architect, build, and test our cold outreach sequences across phone, email, and LinkedIn targeting SMB decision-makers across Germany.
  • Map & Test New Personas: Experiment with outreach strategies for secondary personas, including holding companies, VC/PE portfolio managers, and corporate service providers, to help define our expanded ICP.
  • Generate High-Volume Pipeline: Own top-of-funnel growth by sourcing, qualifying, and booking high-intent discovery meetings for the Founding Account Executive.
  • Design the Playbook: Partner directly with Sales Leadership to document what works, establishing the framework, templates, and best practices for future SDR hires.
  • Leverage AI & Sales Infrastructure: Help select, implement, and optimize our AI-native prospecting stack, utilizing AI tools to automate research, trigger tracking, and hyper-personalized messaging.
  • Continuous Feedback Loop: Gather market feedback from prospect interactions to help refine product positioning, objections handling, and GTM messaging.


Your Profile

  • 1–3 years of outbound prospecting experience (SDR/BDR) in B2B FinTech, SaaS, or financial services, preferably within the DACH market.
  • Founding/Builder mindset: High agency, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated by creating processes from scratch rather than just executing existing ones.
  • Persona curiosity: Ability to speak the language of SMB founders and CFOs, with a strong interest in learning how different corporate entities and treasury setups operate.
  • Tech-savvy & AI-native: Active user of modern sales stacks and AI prospecting tools to maximize outreach efficiency.
  • Tenacious & resilient: Motivated by raw pipeline creation, testing new angles, and iterating quickly based on response data.
  • Languages: Full professional fluency in German and English is required.


Why Join Vivid?

  • Hybrid or remote way of work. You can work from our Berlin office or fully remote from other locations. 
  • Direct influence on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth. 
  • Significant ownership from day one and strong growth opportunities. 
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

description_html:
Gestalte den Versorgungsmarkt der Zukunft mit uns!

Du möchtest Abschlüsse nicht nur erstellen, sondern Accounting-Prozesse in einem internationalen Softwareunternehmen aktiv mitgestalten?

Als Senior Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für unsere Finanzprozesse und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Abschlüsse zuverlässig, transparent und aussagekräftig sind. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Director Finance & Legal zusammen und entwickelst unsere Prozesse Schritt für Schritt weiter.

Cuculus entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Energieversorger weltweit. Dich erwartet ein internationales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, viel Eigenverantwortung – und der Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Abschlüsse: Du erstellst eigenständig Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB und IFRS – dabei stellst du die Qualität und Vollständigkeit unserer Finanzdaten sicher.
  • Bewertungen & Abgrenzungen: Du bewertest Rückstellungen und Vorräte und stellst periodengerechte Abgrenzungen sicher.
  • Steuern: Du bereitest Steuererklärungen vor, betreust Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldungen und begleitest Betriebsprüfungen.
  • Kontenabstimmung & Audits: Du stimmst Haupt- und Nebenbücher ab und arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Auditor:innen zusammen.
  • Laufende Buchhaltung: Du verantwortest die laufende Buchhaltung mit und sorgst für die korrekte Erfassung, Prüfung und Abstimmung der Geschäftsvorfälle – von Debitoren und Kreditoren bis zum Hauptbuch.
  • KI & Automatisierung: Du bringst Ideen ein, wie wir Routinearbeit reduzieren und Finance-Prozesse optimieren können – und setzt dies gemeinsam mit dem Director Finance & Legal um.


Dein Profil

  • Accounting-Erfahrung: Mindestens fünf Jahre im Accounting mit Abschlussverantwortung. 
  • Qualifikation: Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK), kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Finanz- und Rechnungswesen oder vergleichbar. Erfahrung aus einer Steuerberatung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.
  • HGB & IFRS: Fundierte Kenntnisse, die du in der Praxis sicher anwendest.
  • Systeme: Excel gehört für dich zum Arbeitsalltag. Sage 100 und Candis sind ein Plus.
  • KI-Affinität: Du nutzt KI-Tools bereits im Arbeitsalltag - oder hast Lust, damit anzufangen.
  • Englisch & Deutsch: Unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch - gute Englischkenntnisse sind also ein Muss. Außerdem kommunizierst du verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch mit Steuerberatung, Behörden und Auditor:innen. 
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert und lösungsorientiert, setzt selbstständig Prioritäten und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig auf dem Tisch liegen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Du möchtest nicht einfach bestehende Prozesse verwalten, sondern deinen Verantwortungsbereich aktiv mitgestalten.


Warum wir?

Wir glauben, dass gute Arbeit Verantwortung, Vertrauen und den nötigen Freiraum braucht. Deshalb bekommst du bei Cuculus die Möglichkeit, deine Expertise einzubringen und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Finance-Bereichs aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Mit regelmäßiger Office-Präsenz (2–3 Tage/Woche in Erfurt oder Leipzig)
  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Workation-Option (bis zu 4 Wochen/Jahr)
  • Mobilität: 50 % Zuschuss fürs Deutschlandticket & Bike Leasing
  • Sicherheit: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge & vermögenswirksame Leistungen
  • Kultur: Kurze Entscheidungswege, offene Feedbackkultur & echtes Vertrauen
  • Onboarding: Damit du gut ankommst, bekommst du bei uns einen Einarbeitungsplan und einen Buddy an deine Seite.
  • Office-Leben: Wir kommen gern in unseren Offices zusammen, sei es auf einen Kaffee, ein gemeinsames Mittagessen oder ein spontanes Afterwork.
  • Impact: Arbeit mit Sinn - mit unserer Software unterstützt du indirekt Energieversorger weltweit dabei, die Transformation des Energiemarkts voranzutreiben.

title: Senior GenAI Solution Engineer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Eraneos
description_html:
What you can expect from us

We are a technical, implementation-oriented spin-off of a global management consultancy. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies, which we advise on issues in the areas of analytics, big data and machine learning. Within the group, we take on the development of individual and data-driven solutions in order to transform our clients into AI-powered companies. We offer an international working environment with agile teams and creative startup methods as well as above-average remuneration and numerous additional benefits. With our offices in Hamburg, Munich and Düsseldorf and our hub locations in all other major German cities (Berlin, Frankfurt and Stuttgart), we ensure that all colleagues are integrated into our team of experts across Germany.

Your role as a Senior GenAI Solution Engineer:

  • End-to-End Development: You drive AI solutions across the full lifecycle - from rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept to deployment in scalable, highly available production environments.
  • AI Services Engineering: You build robust backend services in Python that seamlessly integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and perform reliably under production load.
  • Autonomous Agent Architecture: You design and implement intelligent agent systems that automate real-world workflows through tool calling and memory management, operating safely within defined guardrails.
  • Agentic SDLC: You integrate AI agents into the development lifecycle - from AI-assisted coding and code reviews to automated testing and intelligent documentation - enhancing efficiency across the entire software development process through agentic tools.
  • Ensuring Software Excellence: You take ownership of code quality by applying clean architecture principles, implementing automated testing, and establishing efficient CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth and reliable deployments.
  • Evaluation & Monitoring: You implement frameworks to measure the performance of GenAI solutions (e.g., accuracy, latency, cost) and ensure continuous optimization.
  • Consulting: You work directly with clients - facilitating workshops and acting as a sparring partner for business and management stakeholders. You translate complex AI concepts into tangible business impact and co-create the right solutions.
  • Technology Sparring: You assess technical feasibility and advise stakeholders on how to turn innovative ideas into sustainable, production-ready products.


Who you are

  • Excellent Python Skills (Production-Ready): You have strong expertise in API development (e.g., FastAPI, Pydantic), containerization (Docker), testing (unit and integration), as well as Git and CI/CD - well beyond notebook-based scripting.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Ability to quickly build and visualize demos and proof-of-concepts.
  • Strong Architectural Understanding: You apply SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, dependency injection, and async/concurrency patterns in a structured way, and leverage ORMs (e.g., SQLAlchemy) for clean and efficient database interactions.
  • Hands-on Experience with Multimodal LLM APIs: Proficient in working with leading models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) and cloud platforms (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
  • Advanced GenAI Engineering: Strong command of prompt engineering, structured outputs (JSON), and tool/function calling.
  • RAG Expertise (End-to-End): Experience in building full pipelines - from embeddings and vector databases (e.g., pgvector) to advanced retrieval, re-ranking, and evaluation.
  • Agent Development: Experience in designing and orchestrating autonomous systems (e.g., with Pydantic AI), including memory management and guardrails.
  • Consulting Skills: Experience working directly with clients. You are able to facilitate workshops, present results, and confidently navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Languages: Fluent in German (C1), with professional proficiency in English.
  • Education: Completed degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a comparable field (Bachelor’s degree or higher).
  • Willingness to travel: You are willing to work on-site at the client’s premises on a regular basis


Who we are

  • Shape the future with (Gen)AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
  • Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
  • Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority


Contact

Paulina Krzeminski
Lead Group Recruiting Consultant - Data & AI

E: M: +49 151 422 09 376

title: Manager SAP EWM – Logistics / Supply Chain (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Eraneos
description_html:
What you can expect from us

As the business-side EWM project lead, you take overall responsibility in our client projects for the planning, management and successful implementation of our SAP EWM initiatives from a Logistics perspective.

You ensure that our clients’ operational requirements define the framework for the solution. To achieve this, you define functional objectives together with the client, set priorities and steer internal IT, external SAP consultants and other service providers so that robust, practical and sustainable solutions are delivered.

You act as the central interface between Logistics, IT and implementation partners and represent our clients’ business interests clearly and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for the overall functional management of SAP EWM projects for our clients, including implementation, roll-out, optimization and, where applicable, migration from SAP WM to SAP EWM, from a Logistics / Supply Chain perspective.
  • Together with our clients, you define the functional objectives, requirements and success criteria for warehouse and intralogistics processes and ensure that these are implemented consistently by IT and implementation partners.
  • You coordinate and lead functional key users, process owners and, where applicable, internal EWM experts on the client side and support the development of a strong and reliable business team around EWM.
  • You manage external SAP implementation partners, developers and technical service providers from a functional perspective: you define requirements, priorities and acceptance criteria and monitor the quality of delivery.
  • You are responsible for functional test management, including test design, test cases, UAT and sign-off, as well as business-side cutover planning and the preparation and support of go-live and the hypercare phase.
  • You establish clear project governance from a business perspective, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting to Logistics management and the steering committee, as well as issue and change management.
  • You drive change communication, training and employee enablement on the client side and ensure that a capable and sustainable business organization is in place after project completion.


Who you are

You combine strong logistics and process expertise with a good understanding of SAP EWM and the ability to translate business requirements into robust, practical solutions. You are comfortable navigating complex project and decision-making environments, manage different stakeholders with clarity and commitment, and challenge existing approaches with confidence. At the same time, you are comfortable working in a consulting environment and take ownership in demanding client projects.

In addition, you bring the following:

  • At least 5 years of experience in management consulting or in relevant industry roles with a focus on Logistics, Intralogistics or Supply Chain, ideally with responsibility for warehouse, distribution or production logistics.
  • A university degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering or a comparable qualification.
  • A strong understanding of warehouse and intralogistics processes, including goods receipt, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, inventory and returns, as well as their interfaces with Production, Sales and Quality Management.
  • Experience in leading or playing a key role in the management of digitalization or SAP projects, ideally with a focus on SAP EWM and/or SAP S/4HANA.
  • A good practical understanding of SAP EWM and related logistics modules such as MM, SD, PP, QM and, where applicable, TM, without the need for deep technical customizing expertise.
  • Proven expertise in requirements management, process design, test management, change management and stakeholder management.
  • Experience in managing external SAP implementation partners and interdisciplinary teams, as well as the ability to provide clear functional leadership to IT teams and consultants.
  • A structured, solution-oriented and dependable way of working, combined with assertiveness, diplomatic skills and a hands-on mindset.
  • Very good German and good English skills, both written and spoken.


Who we are

We are a global digital transformation consulting firm with offices in Hamburg, Düsseldorf, Munich, Vienna, Atlanta, Singapore, and Shanghai. Since 2006, we have primarily advised DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies on digital transformation issues at the intersection of business and IT. Our strength lies in a comprehensive management-level consulting approach that ranges from IT strategy to the optimization and implementation of digitalization and transformation processes. For this, we have repeatedly been recognized by our clients and the business magazine BrandEins as “Best Consultants” and by Wirtschaftswoche as the winner of the “Best of Consulting” competition.

A few of our great benefits:

  • A "Duz-Kultur", short communication channels, and many fantastic, experienced, and international colleagues
  • International company events that are truly worthwhile—both professionally and personally
  • Want a Deutschlandticket? We cover half the cost
  • Childcare subsidy — we pay half the daycare costs for your little ones
  • JobRad bike leasing and discounted gym membership (EGYM Wellpass)
  • Personalized professional development opportunities that help you grow both professionally and personally
  • Central location in downtown Hamburg, Düsseldorf and Munich with excellent bus and train connections— and hub locations in all major German cities
  • Fresh fruit, good coffee, snacks, soft drinks, and after-work beer—we’ve got it all


Contact

If you have any questions in advance, please contact Carolin Hilden at career.de.

Our top priority is that you fit in with us and we with you, regardless of origin, nationality, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity, age, disability or other aspects of diversity.

Please apply via our company portal with your CV and / or your updated Xing or Linked In profile.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Eraneos
description_html:
What you can expect from us

Eraneos supports AI initiatives from strategy all the way through to production. In most AI projects, there's a gap between the strategy and what actually ends up running in production and creating real value. That's exactly the gap we close. 

For us, the work doesn't stop at the concept stage, and it doesn't start only once the spec is finished: an initiative stays in one pair of hands from the first idea to the running system. We work in a results-driven way rather than following the classic consulting model. Our clients are primarily DAX and Fortune Global 500 companies. 

You help decide what gets built, not just how. We always work with the latest models and tools to succeed with the client. There's no prescribed stack — instead, we pick the right tool for each task. You design technical solutions from the first idea through to production deployment, working closely with decision-makers on both the client and management side. 

What to expect:

  • You own the architecture and technical implementation of the AI solution end to end — from strategy through to production
  • You build agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and LLM integrations in real enterprise environments
  • Agentic coding tools are your everyday toolkit: you use them to develop solutions, speed up reviews, and build deployment pipelines
  • You're involved from the very first idea, not just once the spec is finished — growing deeper into the strategic and business side along the way
  • You stay accountable until the end: you don't hand things off, you see the solution through until it's running and delivering impact
  • You represent your technical decisions directly at executive level and lead these conversations yourself, without going through an intermediary layer


Who you are

  • You stand behind the whole outcome, not just one part of it. You stick with it until the solution is running in production and delivering impact, and you share in the responsibility for that — a founder and product mindset rather than simply executing tasks
  • You build hands-on, at the highest level — and you think beyond the code. From an engineering perspective, that means you've already taken LLM-based systems into production and understand the business rationale behind them, not just the architecture
  • You're convincing at executive level. You've already owned and defended technical decisions directly in front of top management. You bring this with you — we won't be developing you into it
  • Proven experience bringing LLM-based systems into production — ideally as a Forward-Deployed or Founding Engineer
  • Excellent, production-grade Python skills (e.g. FastAPI, containers, Git, CI/CD) and a deep understanding of agentic architectures, retrieval methods, and function calling
  • You use agentic coding tools as a core part of your toolkit, not as a gimmick — including building deployment pipelines
  • An appetite for picking up where classic engineering roles leave off, and for growing deeper into the strategic side
  • Ideally, experience in one of our core industries — Financial Services, Transportation & Logistics, Energy & Utilities, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Public Sector, Automotive, or Defence. More important than the specific industry is that you quickly get up to speed in a new, often regulated environment
  • German (at least C1) and business-fluent English
  • Willingness to work regularly on-site at client locations
  • A completed degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, business informatics, or a comparable field (Bachelor's or higher)


Who we are

  • Shape the future with AI by working on diverse and impactful projects at the intersection of strategy, technology, and business.
  • Work flexibly in a way that suits your life – with hybrid working models, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home.
  • Enjoy an open, collaborative culture with flat hierarchies, an international team, and colleagues who are always willing to share their knowledge and support one another.
  • A Great Place to Grow: Benefit from tailored learning opportunities, individualized career paths, and dedicated support for your professional and personal development.
  • Be part of a strong international network of more than 1,300 colleagues and enjoy regular cross-office and international company events.
  • Maintain a healthy work-life balance with flexible working models and, where appropriate, the opportunity to take a sabbatical.
  • Take advantage of our Company Bike program and a subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership to support your health and wellbeing.
  • Work from modern, centrally located offices in Hamburg, Munich, and Düsseldorf, as well as flexible hub locations across Germany's major cities.
  • Enjoy complimentary drinks, fresh fruit, snacks, premium coffee – and, if you like, an after-work beer with your colleagues.
  • Thrive in an environment built on trust, ownership, and continuous growth, where your ideas are valued regardless of your role or level of seniority

description_html:
It’s time to change. We change!

Über uns
It’s time to change. We change! Willkommen bei Auvaria, wo Leidenschaft, Teamgeist und Verantwortung unsere Kultur prägen. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter AWS Consulting & Engineering Partner mit Büros in Wien, Hamburg und Belgrad und begleiten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor auf der gesamten Cloud Journey.

Über die Rolle
Was auch immer unsere Kunden im Bereich Data & AI auf AWS vorhaben, wir entwerfen und entwickeln es gemeinsam vom ersten Architecture Workshop bis in Production mit ihnen. Dafür suchen wir dich: als Senior Solutions Architect für Data & AI verantwortest du End-to-End Projekte in deinem Bereich und gestaltest unsere wachsende Data & AI Business Unit aktiv mit.

Architektur & Delivery 

  • Du führst die Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbare AWS-Architekturen für Data Platforms und Gen AI- / Agentic AI-Lösungen
  • Du sorgst für Security, Performance, Reliability und Kosteneffizienz bei unseren Kunden (AWS Well-Architected)
  • Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen samt Trade-offs – und dokumentierst sie so, dass Teams darauf aufbauen können
  • Du übersetzt vage Business-Pain-Points in messbare technische Anforderungen und klare Ziele
  • Du bringst Außenperspektive ein und hebst unsere bestehenden Standards auf das nächste Level.
  • Du beteiligst dich bei technical Pre-Sales, Scoping von Projekten und arbeitest an der Erstellung der Statements of Work
Data & AI 
  • Du entwickelst Generative AI und Agentic AI Solutions auf AWS Bedrock, mit Frameworks wie Strands Agents und Runtime- / Governance-Bausteinen wie Bedrock AgentCore
  • Du entwickelst Agenten-Architekturen mit Tool Use und MCP-basierten Integrationen, Multi-Step-Orchestrierung und klar definierten Grenzen des Agent-Scopes
  • Du baust Human-in-the-Loop-Patterns ein, von Approval-Steps und Eskalationslogik bis zu (teil-)automatisierten Review-Schleifen
  • Du etablierst Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung für LLM- und Agent-Systeme
  • Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie GenAI und Agentic AI pragmatisch und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen
Consulting & Pre-Sales 
  • Du bist Trusted Technical Advisor für unsere Kunden
  • Du unterstützt Pre-Sales und technische Workshops
  • Du übersetzt komplexe Technik in klaren Business Value
  • Knowledge Sharing
  • Du bist Mentor:in für unsere Junior-Kolleg:innen
  • Du bringst dich in interne Standards, Best Practices und Trainings ein und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter


Dein Profil:

Must-haves 

  • 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen
  • Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen
  • Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten
  • Sehr gute Python-Skills
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch; Deutsch auf professionellem Niveau

Nice-to-haves 
  • AWS-Zertifizierungen
  • Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung
  • Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten
  • Erfahrung mit AWS Connect
  • Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar)
  • Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation
  • Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle)
  • Erfahrung mit Kafka/Streaming


Erstklassige Benefits für deine Karriere!

Vergütung und Vergütungspaket
Bei Auvaria bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job, weil wir davon überzeugt sind, dass Performance nur unter den richtigen Bedingungen gelingen kann:

  • 4-Tage-Woche (bei 36h reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit) mit vollem Fokus auf Impact.
  • Attraktives Package mit teilweise variablem Gehaltsbestandteil, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung.
  • Schneller, transparenter Hiring-Prozess (in der Regel max. 3 Gespräche, Angebot typischerweise innerhalb von 4 Wochen).
  • Persönliches Mentoring und strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag 1. AWS-Zertifizierungen komplett von uns bezahlt.
  • Remote-freundliches Setup mit wenig Reisetätigkeit (max. 20 % im Jahresschnitt). Regelmäßige Team- und Afterwork-Events an unseren Standorten plus gemeinsame Offsites.
Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen!

description_html:
MIT DIR GEMEINSAM: DIE ZUKUNFT BEWEGEN!

Sammle Praxiserfahrung in Finance & Digitalisierung – mitten in der Prozessautomatisierung
 
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Data Science, BWL oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen endlich in der Praxis anwenden? Du interessierst dich für Daten, digitale Prozesse und Automatisierung, arbeitest strukturiert und möchtest Teil eines motivierten Teams werden? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
 
Bei ecotel arbeitest du nicht nur mit – du gestaltest mit. Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team im Bereich Commissions im operativen Tagesgeschäft und erhältst spannende Einblicke in die Automatisierung von Finanzprozessen. Dabei arbeitest du mit Daten, unterstützt bei bestehenden Prozessen und lernst moderne Technologien und Schnittstellen kennen.
 
Das erwartet dich
 
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du unser Team bei der Durchführung, Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Prozesse im Finanzbereich. Dabei übernimmst du klar definierte Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest an kleineren Daten- und Automatisierungsthemen mit.
 
Unter anderem unterstützt du bei:
 

  • Pflege und Überwachung bestehender ETL-Prozesse sowie automatisierter Abläufe
  • Durchführung von Datenvalidierungen, Tests und Qualitätsprüfungen
  • Unterstützung bei Monatsabschlussprozessen und Ad-hoc-Anfragen
  • Mitarbeit an Automatisierungen mit Python, SQL und REST-APIs

description_html:
Kurzbeschreibung

Du liebst es, Menschen und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammenzubringen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Als (Senior) Relationship & Recruiting Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Besetzung anspruchsvoller Fach- und Projektpositionen im Industrie- und Energiesektor. Dabei begleitest Du Freelancer von der ersten Ansprache bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung und arbeitest eng mit unserem Account Management zusammen.
Mit Deinem Gespür für Menschen, Deinem Blick auf den Markt und Deiner Leidenschaft für Recruiting identifizierst Du die besten Experten, führst Interviews, entwickelst nachhaltige Talentpools und berätst Kunden sowie Kandidaten als vertrauensvoller Ansprechpartner. Gleichzeitig bringst Du eigene Ideen ein, optimierst Prozesse und trägst aktiv zum Wachstum unseres Geschäfts bei.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess zur Besetzung spannender, nationaler und internationaler Positionen in Unternehmensübergreifenden Bereichen – von Projektmanagern, über SAP und PLM Spezialisten, bis hin zu Engineering Rollen – und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem Account Management im 180°- Modell zusammen.
  • Du beobachtest den aktuellen Kandidatenmarkt und trittst bei unseren Kunden und Beratern als Experte rund um das Thema Recruiting auf.
  • Du gehst auf unterschiedlichen Businessportalen aktiv auf die Suche nach Experten, pitchst die zu besetzende Position und begeisterst potenzielle Kandidaten für uns und unsere Kunden.
  • Du analysierst CV´s und führst Interviews, um einen optimalen Fit sicherzustellen und die beste Vorauswahl für Deine Projekte zu treffen.
  • Du begleitest deine Experten entlang des gesamten Besetzungsprozesses vom Erstkontakt bis zur erfolgreichen Vermittlung, verhandelst Konditionen und stehst beratend zur Seite.
  • Du sorgst für eine nachvollziehbare und gute Struktur in unserem CRM und baust den Kandidatenpool weiter aus
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen und betreust mehrere Großkunden


Dein Profil

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Berufserfahrungen im Recruiting von bereichsübergreifenden Positionen im Industrie und Energiesektor oder verwandten Berufsfeldern und kennst die Personaldienstleistungsbranche.
  • Du kannst erste Erfolge in der Entwicklung effektiver Recruitingstrategien nachweisen und verstehst es, eine Kandidatenpipeline aufzubauen.
  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen Tools und bist bereit, neue Wege zu gehen, um die besten Experten zu finden.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Datenmanagement von CRM Daten.
  • Du hast eine Leidenschaft für das Peoplebusiness, gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu und hast Spaß an der Kommunikation mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern.
  • Du hast Spaß daran Prozesse zu verbessern und aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Du lebst eine ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem hohen Maß an Eigeninitiative und Durchhaltevermögen.
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über einen Hochschulabschluss aus dem Bereich Wirtschaft
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1 Niveau) und sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. B2-C1 Niveau).


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket mit zusätzlichen Benefits
  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Mentor ab Tag 1, interne & externe Trainings
  • Modernste Technik und Ausstattung um sich auf die wesentlichen Dinge zu konzentrieren
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage zzgl. 24.12. und 31.12., Homeoffice & flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Teamtag: Mittwochs treffen wir uns alle im Büro um die Gemeinschaft zu stärken und werden auch mit einem Team-Lunch gestärkt
  • Mobilität & Familie: MVV-Zuschuss (bis 100 €/Monat), Kinderbetreuungszuschuss
  • Extras: Spendit-Karte (47 €/Monat), Zugang zu Wellhub, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, kostenlose Getränke & frisches Obst
  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Münchens mit Dachterrasse, welche zum verweilen einlädt
  • Teamspirit: Regelmäßige Events & ein motiviertes Umfeld sowie ein modernes Büro mit bester technischer Ausstattung

title: Account Executive – Full-Cycle, New Business (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mute Labs Gmbh
description_html:
THE JOB

Reading this to the end is worth it.

The Company: Why mute-labs?


mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back.


We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you.


Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires.


The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel


This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing.


  • Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it.

  • Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script.

  • Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on.

  • Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once.

  • A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one.

  • A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers.


Is This You?


  • The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you.

  • Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here.

  • Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread.

  • Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role.

  • Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language.


Our Hiring Process


We keep this fast and honest, on both sides.


  1. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit.

  2. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team.

  3. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal.

  4. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here.


ABOUT US

mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart:


  • We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need.

  • We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one.

  • We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake.

  • We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations.



Skip the Queue

Told you it was worth reading to the end.


We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Cold call your future manager, Patrick, directly.


+49 15888 279908


If you get through and make your case, you've already shown us more than any CV could.

description_html:
Your mission

Cloud Native Node.js & AI-enabled Product with SAP Private Cloud Integration | Senior / Principal Level 

As Senior Technical Architect – Hybrid, you own the technical design across our two worlds: the cloud-native, AI-enabled product line built on modern Node.js architectures, and its integration into the SAP Private Cloud platform landscape. 
Your focus is approximately 70% Public Cloud product architecture and 30% SAP Private Cloud platform architecture. You are the architect who makes the hybrid seam work – ensuring that public cloud innovation and the SAP core evolve as one coherent, scalable, and future-proof landscape rather than two disconnected estates. 

Your Responsibilities 

  • Cloud-Native Product Architecture (Primary Focus)
Design of microservices architectures on Node.js 
API-first and event-driven architecture concepts 
Definition of service boundaries, data flows, and integration patterns 
Ensuring multi-tenant capability and tenant isolation 
Non-functional design: performance, scalability, resilience, cost 
  • AI Integration in Product
Technical architecture for AI features in the product 
Integration of LLMs or AI services within defined guardrails 
Design of RAG and agentic patterns over product and platform data 
Performance and cost optimization of AI-driven features 
  • Hybrid Integration Architecture (Public ↔ Private Cloud)
Design of the integration layer between cloud-native products and SAP S/4HANA Private Cloud 
API and event contracts across the hybrid boundary (OData, REST, SAP Business Events, Event Mesh) 
Data ownership, consistency, and synchronisation patterns across both estates 
Identity, authorisation, and trust propagation across the hybrid landscape 
  • SAP Private Cloud Platform Architecture (Secondary Focus)
Architectural guidance for S/4HANA Private Cloud extensions and side-by-side scenarios 
Enforcement of clean core principles and SAP development standards 
Architectural review of SAP-side designs together with the SAP Private Cloud & SCM architect 
Awareness of core SCM process flows (SD, MM, EWM) as they surface into product capabilities 
  • DevOps & Deployment Architecture
Collaboration with infrastructure and deployment engineers across both estates 
Architecture design for containerization and cloud deployment

title: SAP Account Executive (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Implico Gmbh
description_html:
Deine Aufgaben

Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst.  Dein Umfeld weiß es auch.  Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst.   Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten. Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast.  Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird?   Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade. 

Die Rolle

 Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke. 
 
Deine Verantwortung

  • Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
  • Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
  • Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
  • Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
  • Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
  • Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams


Dein Profil

Was wir voraussetzen:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
  • Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
  • Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
  • Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
  • Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch
Was dich zusätzlich auszeichnet:
  • Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
  • Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
  • Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
  • Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
 
Was du bei uns findest
  • Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
  • Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
  • Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
  • Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
  • Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.

 Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
 
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.

 "Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest.  Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen. Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie.  Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
 
Der nächste Schritt

 Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

title: Working Student (m/f/d)​Indexing Platform
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Solactive
description_html:
Company Description

Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape.


Job Overview

Solactive's Aggregate team owns the intraday calculation of our indices: consuming live price streams, applying calculation logic across a wide range of indices, and producing a continuous output stream of index ticks throughout the trading day. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
  • Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
  • Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
  • Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family  an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
  • Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
  • Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
  • Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.


Your Application

This role sounds like you? Then we look forward to receiving your application.  Please make sure to also upload your CV, a cover letter is not compulsory. If you have any futher questions just drop us an email! Sonia Urusaro -  
No artificial intelligence (AI) is used in the screening, assessment, or selection of candidates for this position. 
Solactive does not charge candidates any fees at any stage of the recruitment process and will never request payment for CV enhancement, interviews, training, equipment, or other recruitment-related services. The core platform is built in Java and engineered around throughput, latency, and correctness under concurrency, while custom business integrations are built in Python. As a Working Student you join a small team and contribute real, production-bound code to both, working alongside senior engineers who review your work and coach you.


Your Tasks

  • Implement well-scoped features and fixes in the Java calculation platform, such as improvements to calculation components, price stream consumption, or index tick production
  • Write unit, integration, and performance tests, including tests for concurrent code paths where ordering and timing matter
  • Help investigate correctness or performance issues: reproduce them, narrow them down, and propose fixes with senior guidance
  • Build and maintain Python integrations for business teams: connectors to the calculation platform, output adapters, validation checks, and small operational tools
  • Contribute to monitoring and developer tooling that makes calculation behaviour observable and easier to reason about
  • Take part in design and code reviews, ask questions, and document what you learn so the next person can pick it up faster


Your Profile

  • Enrolled student in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field
  • Strong Java fundamentals: object-oriented design, collections, generics, and comfort reading and writing idiomatic modern Java
  • Solid grounding in core computer science: data structures, algorithms, and complexity, and in particular a working understanding of multithreading and concurrency (threads, synchronisation, memory visibility, races and deadlocks)
  • Openness to Python: no prior experience needed, but willingness to pick it up for integration and tooling work alongside Java
  • Familiarity with Git, the command line, and a testing mindset; interest in measuring performance rather than guessing at it
  • Ability to work independently on a scoped task, ask for help early when stuck, and communicate clearly in writing
  • Available for 15–20 hours per week during the semester, more during semester breaks
  • Interest in financial markets, market data, or index calculation is welcome but not required


Our Offer

  • Be part of the Solactive family  an international FinTech environment with flat hierarchies, real ownership, and strong growth opportunities.
  • Enjoy attractive benefits such as team events, Corporate Benefits access, a modern ergonomic office,free beverages and fruit.
  • Work on a real, high-impact production platform and contribute to architectural improvements not just feature tickets.
  • Gain hands-on experience with Java microservices, build systems, and dependency governance while collaborating with experienced engineers.
  • Build practical backend engineering skills that directly support your long-term career development.

    Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational databases.

  • Practical fullstack ability: comfortable building internal tooling / lightweight
    frontends; frontend framework can be defined together with the team.
  • Track record of designing scalable, resilient systems and taking features from
    concept to production.
  • A proactive mindset: you spot gaps and opportunities before they're handed to
    you, and you act on them.
  • A strong drive for teamwork: you collaborate across functions, share context
    generously, and lift the people around you rather than optimizing solo.
  • The ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, mentoring mindset.

  • Experience with GCP in particular (Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage / buckets).
  • Working knowledge of Python (the team has Python components).

  • Experience with document generation / rendering pipelines (PDF, XLS/CSV,
