In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets in DACH, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

description_html:
Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. The Director, AI Engineering & Platform will lead this team and will be responsible for building, operating, and evolving the technical foundation for production AI services across our client.

This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States.

In addition to leading delivery and operations, this person will continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, model providers, open-source frameworks, agentic workflow patterns, and industry capabilities. They will be expected to make clear recommendations on where our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate in order to improve speed, quality, cost, automation, and product differentiation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.

  • Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.

  • Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns.

  • Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs.

  • Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing.

  • Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap.

  • Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs.

  • Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • [10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience).

  • Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.

  • Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms.

  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems.

  • Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering.

  • Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms.

  • Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms.

  • Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership.

  • Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration.

  • Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems.

  • Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems.

  • Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments.

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Deeptech Recruitment
description_html:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

  • Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

  • Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

  • Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

  • Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

  • Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

  • Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

  • Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

  • Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

  • The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience

  • Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

  • LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

  • ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

  • Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

Interview process

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

BUILD THE IMPOSSIBLE. WE’LL FIND THE PEOPLE.

Deep Tech Recruitment connects ambitious technology companies with the engineers and leaders who can turn difficult ideas into products that perform in the real world.

Key responsibilities

We're seeking a talented Platform Engineer who is eager to enhance their expertise in security. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and gain hands-on experience in "policy as code" frameworks while contributing to our dynamic team.

In this role, you will:

  • Build, manage, and optimize cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and CloudFormation.

  • Automate system configurations using tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

  • Collaborate with teams to ensure seamless integration of infrastructure with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Gain experience working with policy as code frameworks (e.g., Open Policy Agent, HashiCorp Sentinel).

  • Assist in translating high-level security requirements into practical policy as code implementation within cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Support the implementation and scaling of automated security controls in Kubernetes, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and operating systems.x5

  • Stay updated on infrastructure management and automation trends, ensuring a robust and scalable system foundation

Required qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.

  • Proficiency in configuration management tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

  • Solid understanding of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and its core services.

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Willingness to learn and grow into a role focused on security policies and automation.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with security tools and concepts such as policy as code frameworks (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel).

  • Knowledge of compliance standards (e.g., CIS, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

  • Previous exposure to cloud-native security tools and services.

  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • A keen interest in learning about security best practices, frameworks, and tools.

Application Process

As part of your application, please share links to your GitHub/GitLab repositories or a portfolio of projects that demonstrate your experience with security policy implementation, policy as code, and relevant cloud security tools. We're particularly interested in seeing examples that showcase your ability to translate complex security requirements into executable code for cloud environments.

If you're passionate about enhancing cloud security through code, implementing scalable and automated security policies across cloud platforms, participating in collaborative security design processes, and staying at the forefront of cloud security best practices, we'd love to hear from you!

description_html:
Propulsion Engineer - Solid Rocket Motors

We are looking for a Propulsion Engineer to support the design, development, manufacture, testing, and qualification of the solid rocket motors used on our orbital launch vehicle. This is a hands-on role covering the full motor development cycle, from preliminary design through static-fire testing and flight qualification.

 

You will work as part of the project team delivering an orbital-class launch vehicle, contributing to the development of propulsion hardware, engineering analysis, test campaigns, and the tools required to support motor and vehicle-level design.

 

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

 

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

 

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and development of solid rocket motors from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing readiness, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Perform engineering analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, motor performance, nozzle design, motor cases, and structural sizing.

  • Develop or extend Python-based analysis and simulation tools for ballistic simulation, performance prediction, structural sizing, and related design activities.

  • Translate vehicle-level performance requirements—including total impulse, burn time, thrust profile, and mass fraction—into motor-level design specifications.

  • Feed measured motor performance data back into vehicle-level design and sizing tools.

  • Support the definition and execution of verification and validation activities, including analysis, subscale and component testing, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Support the planning and execution of static-fire test campaigns, including instrumentation requirements, test preparation, and post-test data analysis.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, analysis reports, and clear records of design assumptions and results.

  • Work closely with structures, manufacturing, chemistry, systems, and vehicle engineering teams to manage interfaces and cross-disciplinary design impacts.

  • Contribute to the development of engineering methods, tools, and processes as the propulsion team and company scale.

 

What we are looking for

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Experience or demonstrated academic/project experience in solid rocket motor design, propulsion, aerospace hardware, experimental engineering, or a closely related field.

  • An understanding of several propulsion disciplines, including internal ballistics, grain design, nozzle design, motor case design, or propulsion performance.

  • A strong foundation in thermodynamics and internal ballistics, including combustion, propellant energetics, and burn-rate behaviour.

  • Working knowledge of nozzle flow theory and thrust coefficient behaviour, including off-design and altitude effects.

  • Working knowledge of pressure-vessel and composite structural design principles.

  • Proficiency in Python or a similar programming language for developing and maintaining engineering analysis tools.

  • An understanding of verification and validation approaches for propulsion hardware.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work from first principles when established methods or tools do not exist.

  • The ability to work independently, take responsibility for assigned technical work, and contribute effectively within a small, fast-moving team.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document design assumptions, analysis, and results clearly for a cross-disciplinary team.

 

Desirable experience

  • Direct experience designing, manufacturing, assembling, or testing solid rocket motors.

  • Experience with composite filament-winding process design or qualification.

  • Experience supporting or executing static-fire test campaigns.

  • Experience analysing pressure, force, temperature, or other propulsion test instrumentation data.

  • Propellant formulation or strand-burner testing experience.

  • Experience with explosives licensing, range safety, or similar regulatory processes for propellant systems.

  • Experience at an early-stage aerospace company or in a similar environment.

  • Familiarity with vehicle-level launch-vehicle design, including staging, mass budgeting, performance sizing, or trajectory analysis.

Lead Propulsion Engineer

We are looking for a Lead Propulsion Engineer to provide technical leadership across major solid rocket motor propulsion projects and to help build a high-performing engineering team. You will guide projects from requirements through design, manufacture, testing, qualification, and production readiness, while remaining close to the hardware and supporting the engineers delivering it.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead one or more propulsion projects from initial requirements through design, test, qualification, and production readiness.

  • Set technical direction across internal ballistics, grain design, nozzles, motor cases, structures, manufacturing, and productionisation.

  • Coordinate engineers across propulsion, chemistry, manufacturing, testing, systems, and operations.

  • Review technical work, manage risks and interfaces, and make timely engineering decisions.

  • Support static-fire campaigns and use test data to drive design improvements.

  • Mentor engineers, interns, and thesis students while helping to build scalable engineering processes.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in aerospace, mechanical, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related discipline.

  • Significant experience in propulsion, aerospace hardware, energetic materials, or a closely related field.

  • Experience leading complex technical work or owning a major subsystem or project.

  • Strong understanding of the propulsion development lifecycle and the ability to work across disciplines.

  • A practical, structured approach to solving ambiguous problems and moving projects forward.

  • Strong communication skills and a willingness to work directly with hardware, laboratories, manufacturing, and test operations.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket motor propulsion development.

  • Taking propulsion hardware into repeatable or serial production.

  • Leading static-fire or other high-consequence test campaigns.

  • Propellant formulation, energetic-materials characterisation, or composite motor-case development.

  • Python-based engineering analysis or simulation tools.

  • Explosives licensing, range safety, or hazardous-materials processes.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Principal Thermal-Mechanical Engineer-Munich, Germany
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vinci
description_html:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Compensation: $110K – $140K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Post Market Surveillance Specialist for Medical Devices

description_html:
Help improve patient safety wordwide!

At Novanta Advanced Surgery, we develop innovative technologies that support surgeons around the globe and contribute to better patient outcomes. Our solutions for minimally invasive surgery, including insufflators, pumps, tubing systems, medical visualization, and operating room integration technologies, are trusted by healthcare professionals worldwide.

As a Post Market Surveillance Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring the safety and performance of our medical devices throughout their lifecycle. Your expertise will directly contribute to protecting patients, supporting regulatory compliance, and driving continuous product improvement.

Tasks

What makes this role special?

Every day, your work helps ensure that medical devices used in operating rooms around the world remain safe, effective, and compliant. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, evaluate real-world device performance, interact with regulatory authorities, and help shape critical decisions that impact patient safety.

If you are passionate about medical devices, risk assessment, and global regulatory compliance, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

Your Responsibilities

  • Ensure Patient Safety & Regulatory Compliance
  • Evaluate adverse events using clinical information and device investigation results
  • Assess regulatory reporting obligations based on international requirements
  • Prepare and submit vigilance reports to regulatory authorities worldwide
  • Monitor and evaluate medical device vigilance data from global databases
  • Support benefit-risk evaluations and risk assessments

Drive Post-Market Surveillance Activities

  • Contribute to Health Risk Assessments and safety evaluations
  • Participate in recall and Field Safety Corrective Action (FSCA) assessments
  • Create and maintain recall and FSCA documentation
  • Support Post-Market Surveillance (PMS) and Post-Market Clinical Follow-Up (PMCF) activities
  • Conduct literature reviews and data assessments in accordance with MDR requirements

Collaborate Across Functions

  • Act as a key contact for vigilance-related questions from internal and external stakeholders
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities and customers regarding safety-related topics
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of vigilance processes, SOPs, and compliance systems
  • Work closely with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Risk Management, and Product teams

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Degree in Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare, or a related field
  • Experience within the medical device industry or another highly regulated environment
  • Experience with adverse event reporting and regulatory submissions
  • Knowledge of international vigilance and post-market surveillance requirements
  • Experience in risk assessment and benefit-risk evaluation
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills
  • Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive working style
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and complex workflows
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal

Nice to Have

  • Experience with PMS, PMCF, Vigilance, or Medical Device Reporting activities
  • Knowledge of MDR, MDSAP, or global regulatory requirements
  • Experience with literature reviews and regulatory medical writing
  • German language skills

Benefits

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to directly contribute to patient safety and improve healthcare outcomes
  • An international and collaborative working environment
  • Exposure to global regulatory activities and medical device innovations
  • Cross-functional collaboration with industry experts
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package

Du hast schon in Leitwarten, Umspannwerken oder Produktionshallen getestet und weißt, warum man dort manches nicht anfasst? Du willst Angriffspfade an echten Geräten nachbauen, bevor sie in eine Produktivumgebung gehen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Yekta IT ist ein Familienunternehmen für herstellerunabhängige IT- und OT-Sicherheitsberatung aus Dortmund. Wir prüfen und härten kritische Infrastrukturen, vom Mittelständler bis zum Konzern.

Du arbeitest überwiegend remote aus Deutschland. Vor Ort bist du bei Kundeneinsätzen und wenn du in unserem OT-Labor arbeitest. Dazu kommen flexible Arbeitszeiten, Zugang zu Weiterbildung und Zertifizierungen.

Aufgaben

  • Du führst Penetrationstests und Assessments in OT- und ICS-Umgebungen durch: SCADA, RTUs, IEDs, Schutzrelais, HMIs, Engineering Workstations, SPS (u.a. Siemens S7-300/1200/1500) und die IT/OT-Übergänge
  • Du analysierst industrielle Protokolle: IEC 61850 (GOOSE, MMS, SV), IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP, S7comm und S7commPlus, PROFINET
  • Du baust Angriffspfade in unserem OT-Labor nach und validierst sie dort, bevor sie in eine Produktivumgebung gehen
  • Du stimmst Scope, Safety und Testfenster direkt mit dem Betreiber ab
  • Du dokumentierst Befunde mit Reproduktionsschritten, bewertest Risiken (CVSS, Mapping auf IEC 62443-3-3) und leitest Härtungsmaßnahmen ab, die der Betreiber auch umsetzen kann
  • Du übergibst an die Betreiberseite: Ergebnisbesprechung, Detection-Ideen für SOC und SIEM, Wissenstransfer
  • Du arbeitest in einem Forschungsprojekt zum Thema OT-Security mit
  • Du arbeitest an unserer Testmethodik und unserem Werkzeugbau mit, und wenn du willst, an Veröffentlichungen

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in Penetrationstests, davon einen belastbaren Anteil in OT- oder ICS-Umgebungen
  • Du hast praktisch mit mindestens einem der oben genannten Industrieprotokolle gearbeitet, über Tool-Bedienung hinaus
  • Du kennst die Betriebsrealität in der OT: warum Verfügbarkeit vor Vertraulichkeit steht, wie man in Wartungsfenstern arbeitet, wann man etwas nicht anfasst
  • Du schreibst Berichte, die ein Anlagenverantwortlicher und ein CISO gleichermaßen lesen können
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1) und sicheres Englisch
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine eigene Arbeit
  • Du bist motiviert, zuverlässig und zeigst Eigeninitiative

Optional:

  • Zertifizierungen im Bereich OT/ICS, idealerweise OT-Background
  • Erfahrung im Energiesektor oder Schienenindustrie
  • Eigene Werkzeuge, Forschung, Responsible Disclosures oder Veröffentlichungen
  • Detection-Engineering: SIEM-Regeln, Anomalieerkennung auf Industrieprotokollen

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes OT-Labor mit physischen Testbeds. YekCity für Energie, YekTrain für Bahn, YekCar für Automotive, dazu ein Siemens-S7-Labor, Industrieswitches, SCADA-Arbeitsplätze und HMIs. Echte Geräte, nicht nur virtualisierte Umgebungen.
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit an spannenden Forschungsprojekten mitzuarbeiten und bekommst den Raum dafür
  • Bei uns kannst du wirklich Techie sein. Du musst bei uns kein Sales machen.
  • Du kannst überwiegend remote aus ganz Deutschland arbeiten, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • Du bekommst Zugang zu verschiedenen Lernportalen, Zertifizierungen und kannst an Tech Events teilnehmen.
  • Eine agile, positive Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien wartet auf dich
  • Du hast große Freiheiten, eigene Ideen einzubringen

salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Alteos GmbH
description_html:
These tasks are waiting for you

  • Take technical ownership of Configuration Experience — the team that builds and manages our insurance products — and set the direction for how the team delivers.
  • Spend the bulk of your time hands-on: researching technical solutions, writing RFCs, building PoCs with other teams, and shipping the resulting code yourself.
  • Act as a sparring partner for product managers and stakeholders on key business and technical decisions.
  • Keep delivery on track — plan realistically, follow agile principles, hit deadlines.
  • Lead people by example: give feedback, run team meetings, support colleagues' growth. This is a smaller part of the role — most of your time stays technical.
  • Spot obstacles early, resolve them, and keep stakeholders proactively informed.

This is what you bring to the table

You don't need to tick every box. If this sounds like your kind of work, we want to hear from you.

  • Solid hands-on experience as a software engineer with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • First experience leading or managing people — you don't need years of management under your belt, but you've done it at least once and want to grow into it further.
  • Full-stack understanding across frontend and backend, with a cloud-agnostic mindset.
  • Solid experience working with AI tools in your engineering workflow — Harnesses, delegating tasks to subagents, orchestrating multi-agent setups, and similar. Clear communicator, motivated to grow into building and guiding a team over time.
  • Insurance or finance experience is a plus.

What we offer

Together with our investor, AXA, we offer a combination of entrepreneurial freedom, leading technological know-how, reliability and extensive experience in the conception and management of insurance solutions that is rather unusual for the insurance industry.

When you become part of our team, you can expect to work with incredibly versatile and talented colleagues.

  • The opportunity to lead and grow an exciting team
  • The opportunity to shape the future of insurance by contributing to the strategy and success of Alteos and further advancing one of the worlds leading core insurance systems
  • Modern working in the middle of Berlin's City-West, with a wide range of perks and benefits. To name a few: subsidized lunch & one free lunch a week, discount on BVG ticket, company (e-)bike leasing, urban sports club, mental well-being app
  • Many opportunities to connect with your colleagues outside of daily work, e.g.through team events, weekly yoga classes, team runs and more
  • A flexible work model (hybrid working role)

title: Praktikum UI/UX Design (m/w/d)

description_html:
Wir sind Pangoon, eine Digitalagentur aus Berlin mit einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team und einer großen Leidenschaft für gute digitale Produkte. Seit über 12 Jahren entwickeln wir gemeinsam Websites, Webanwendungen, Apps und individuelle Softwarelösungen, bei denen durchdachtes UI/UX Design eine zentrale Rolle spielt. Von der ersten Idee über Wireframes und Prototypen bis zum fertigen Interface. Dabei legen wir Wert auf klare Strukturen, intuitive Bedienung und Gestaltung, die nicht nur gut aussieht, sondern auch funktioniert. Als kleines Team arbeiten wir direkt, unkompliziert und auf Augenhöhe miteinander.

Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeit, echte Projekte kennenzulernen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und praktische Erfahrung im UI/UX Design zu sammeln. Ein Einstieg ist jederzeit möglich, auch kurzfristig. Die Dauer des Praktikums kann flexibel zwischen drei und 18 Monaten gestaltet werden.

Aufgaben

  • Mitarbeit an echten Kundenprojekten – von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Design
  • Erstellung von Wireframes, Mockups und interaktiven Prototypen
  • Gestaltung moderner und intuitiver Benutzeroberflächen für Websites, Webanwendungen und Apps
  • Einblicke in den gesamten UI/UX-Prozess und die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Development-Team
  • Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Designsystemen und UI-Komponenten
  • Viel Raum für eigene Ideen, kreatives Ausprobieren und die persönliche Weiterentwicklung deiner Design-Skills

Qualifikation

  • Begeisterung für UI/UX Design und ein gutes Gespür für moderne, digitale Gestaltung
  • Erfahrungen mit Design-Tools wie Figma oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen
  • Verständnis für Usability, Nutzerführung und responsive Design
  • Kreativität, Neugier und Lust darauf, eigene Ideen einzubringen
  • Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein Auge fürs Detail
  • Offenheit für Feedback und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen Team

Benefits

Arbeitsumfeld & Flexibilität

  • Modernes Büro in Berlin Adlershof
  • Homeoffice möglich
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Team & Zusammenarbeit

  • Junges, motiviertes Team
  • Transparente und offene Kommunikation
  • Teamevents, Teamessen und Kulturtage

Lernen & Entwicklung

  • Praktische Einblicke in den Entwicklungsprozess eines Digitalen Produktes
  • Verantwortung und Raum für eigene Ideen
  • Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit nach dem Praktikum (Werkstudium, Abschlussarbeit etc.)

Klingt nach dem richtigen Praktikum für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Schick uns einfach deine Bewerbung mit ein paar Infos über dich, deinem Lebenslauf, und falls vorhanden, ersten Arbeitsproben oder deinem Portfolio.

Uns ist dabei nicht wichtig, dass du schon alles kannst. Viel wichtiger sind uns deine Begeisterung für UI/UX Design, deine Ideen und deine Lust, gemeinsam mit uns an spannenden digitalen Projekten zu arbeiten.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Predium Technology GmbH
description_html:
Unsere Opportunity

Predium hat in den letzten drei Jahren die führende ESG-Intelligence-Plattform für institutionelle Immobilienunternehmen in der DACH-Region gebaut - mit den stärksten Namen der Branche als Kunden: Asset Manager, Wohnungsbaugesellschaften, Banken. Unsere Kundenbasis, die Daten, unsere Glaubwürdigkeit sind wertvolles Kapital für den nächsten Schritt. Investment-, Kredit- und Asset-Management-Entscheidung werden in der Real Estate Branche noch immer in Excel getroffen, Fall für Fall. Wir bauen jetzt den AI-Analysten, der diese Arbeit übernimmt. Direkt auf den Daten des Kunden, skalierbar ohne zusätzliche Köpfe. Wir sind stark finanziert und bringen KI in die Real Estate Branche.

Deine Mission

Als Data Scientist bei Predium baust du an den Modellen, die unsere Plattform antreiben. Mit Statistik, Machine Learning und numerischen Methoden knackst du konkrete Probleme rund um Gebäude, Energieeffizienz und die Dekarbonisierung von Immobilien.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering- und Product-Team zusammen und verwandelst reale Daten in verlässliche analytische, Simulations- und ML-Modelle, die Optimierungspotenziale für nachhaltigere Gebäude aufzeigen und unseren Kunden helfen, fundierte Investitionsentscheidungen zu treffen.

Was du konkret tust

  1. Du entwickelst und verbesserst analytische Modelle, ML-Modelle und Simulationen, um konkrete Probleme im Immobilien- und Energiebereich zu lösen.
  2. Du baust und verbesserst Datenextraktions-Pipelines für strukturierte und unstrukturierte Quellen und prüfst dabei, wie genau und zuverlässig die Extraktion läuft.
  3. Du erkundest und bewertest laufend neue Datenquellen, um die Modellgenauigkeit zu verbessern.
  4. Du prüfst die Datenqualität, deckst Lücken auf und bewertest, wie gut deine Modelle performen - indem du Annahmen und Ergebnisse mit echten Daten und dem Feedback von Fachleuten abgleichst.
  5. Du arbeitest mit Engineers, Product Managern und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen, um aus fachlichen Anforderungen datengetriebene Lösungen zu machen.

Woran wir Erfolg messen

  1. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für klar umrissene Analyse- und Modellierungsprobleme und findest eigenständig robuste Lösungen.
  2. Deine Modelle und Analysen sind reproduzierbar, gut dokumentiert und sauber validiert.
  3. Du übersetzt technische Ergebnisse in das, was sie für unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und unser Geschäft bedeuten.
  4. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering- und Productteam zusammen.
  5. Du holst dir aktiv Feedback ein und nutzt es, um dich fachlich und in deiner Arbeitsweise weiterzuentwickeln

Was du mitbringst

  1. Studienabschluss in Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Fach.
  2. 1-2 Jahre relevante praktische Erfahrung mit Programmierung, idealerweise in Python, aus Projekten wie physikbasierter Modellierung, Machine Learning oder Datenpipelines. Erfahrung mit TypeScript für Produkt-Prototyping ist ein Plus.
  3. Strukturierte, eigenständige Herangehensweise an Probleme.
  4. Neugier auf die Business-Seite und die Fähigkeit, deine Ergebnisse sowohl Tech- als auch Nicht-Tech-Leuten klar zu erklären.
  5. Sichere Kommunikation auf Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Bonus:
  6. Erste Erfahrung mit Optimierungsmethoden, LLM-basierter Datenextraktion oder Unsicherheits- und Sensitivitätsanalysen.
  7. Vertrautheit mit Immobilien, Bauphysik oder Energiesystemen.
  8. Erfahrung mit Tools für physikalische Simulation oder Energiemodellierung.

Warum Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 Leute, stark finanziert, auf dem Weg die Kategorie zu definieren. Früh genug, dass vieles noch gebaut werden muss. Ja, es ist manchmal messy - aber genau das ist der Punkt. Wenn du einen fertigen Playbook-Job suchst, ist das hier nicht der richtige Fit.
  • Impact: Du bist nicht Rädchen #100 in einer Company. Die Modelle, die du baust, fließen direkt in unser Produkt ein und werden von echten Kunden genutzt. Dein Beitrag ist direkt sichtbar, im Revenue und im Produkt.
  • Ownership: Wir managen nicht deine Zeit, wir messen deine Ergebnisse. Du bekommst Verantwortung und Freiraum - und die Erwartung, beides zu nutzen.
  • Compensation: Competitive Salary, Bonus und Equity-Beteiligung. Wir wollen, dass du am Erfolg partizipierst, den du mitaufbaust.
  • Team: Office-first im Werksviertel München, 4 Tage/Woche.

30 Urlaubstage (inkl. Betriebsurlaub) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · Team-Events

title: Associate Data Scientist (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Predium Technology GmbH
description_html:
Our Opportunity

Over the past three years, Predium has built the leading real estate intelligence platform for ESG and value management in the DACH region - with the strongest names in the industry as customers: asset managers, housing companies, banks. Our customer base, our data, our credibility - that's valuable capital for the next step. Investment, credit, and asset management decisions in real estate are still made in Excel, case by case. We're now building the AI analyst that takes this work off people's hands - working directly on the customer's own data, scalable without adding headcount. We're well-funded, and we're bringing AI into real estate.

Your Mission

As a Data Scientist at Predium, you will help develop and improve the data-driven models behind our platform. You will use statistics, machine learning, and numerical methods to solve well-defined problems related to buildings, energy performance, and real-estate decarbonization.
Working closely with our engineering and product team, you will turn real-world data into reliable analytical, simulation, and machine-learning models that identify optimization opportunities for more sustainable buildings and help customers make informed investment decisions.

What you'll own

  1. Develop and improve analytical, machine-learning, and simulation models to address business problems in the real-estate and energy domain.
  2. Build and improve data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured sources, evaluating extraction accuracy and reliability
  3. Continuously explore and evaluate new data sources to improve model accuracy.
  4. Assess data quality, identify gaps and evaluate model performance by validating assumptions and results against real-world data and feedback of domain experts.
  5. Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into data-driven solutions.

What success looks like

  1. You take ownership of well-defined analytical and modeling problems and independently deliver robust solutions.
  2. Your models and analyses are reproducible, well-documented, and supported by appropriate validation.
  3. You translate technical results into clear implications for the product, our customers, and the business.
  4. You collaborate effectively across Data, Engineering and Product teams.
  5. You actively seek feedback and use it to improve both your technical work and your way of working.

What it takes

  1. A degree in data science, computer science, mathematics or a related field.
  2. 1–2 years of relevant hands-on experience, with programming, ideally in Python, through projects in areas such as physics-based modeling, machine learning, or data pipelines. TypeScript experience for product prototyping is a plus.
  3. A structured, independent approach to problem-solving.
  4. Curiosity about business needs and the ability to explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  5. Confident communication in English; German is a plus. Bonus:
  6. Initial experience with optimization methods, LLM-based data extraction, or uncertainty and sensitivity analysis.
  7. Familiarity with real estate, building physics, or energy systems.
  8. Experience with tools for physical simulation or energy modeling.

Why Predium?

  • Stage: ~40 people, well-funded, on the way to defining the category. Early enough that a lot still needs to be built. Yes, it's messy sometimes - that's the whole point. If you're looking for a job with a finished playbook, this isn't the right fit.
  • Impact: You're not cog #100 in some company. The models you build feed straight into our product and get used by real customers. Your contribution shows up directly, in revenue and in the product.
  • Ownership: We don't manage your time, we measure your results. You get responsibility and freedom - and the expectation that you'll use both.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary, bonus, and equity. We want you to share in the success you help create.
  • Team: Office-first in Munich's Werksviertel, 4 days/week.

30 vacation days (including company shutdown days) · Wellpass · Deutschland-Ticket · Jobrad · team events

title: Technical Onboarding Specialist (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Roger
description_html:
In Deutschland geben Patient:innen jährlich unglaubliche 30 Milliarden Euro für Zahnarztbesuche aus. Trotzdem arbeiten viele Zahnarztpraxen immer noch mit veralteter Software aus den 1980er Jahren. Roger setzt hier an, um die Dentalbranche zu revolutionieren. Unser Ziel ist es, moderne, cloudbasierte Technologien in Zahnarztpraxen zu etablieren, um Behandlungsplanung, Patient:innenkommunikation und Arbeitsabläufe für Zahnärzt:innen und ihre Teams zu verbessern.

Unterstützt von führenden Investor:innen aus Europa und den USA wächst unser Startup rasant. Daher suchen wir eine_n_ Technical Onboarding Specialist, der_die_ eine Schlüsselrolle in der reibungslosen Einführung unserer Software bei unseren Kund:innen übernimmt. In dieser Position koordinierst du die Installation einer lokalen Softwarekomponente per Fernzugriff und übernimmst die Konfiguration von Kommunikationskanälen wie WhatsApp.

Diese Position ist remote, daher kannst du flexibel von deinem bevorzugten Standort aus arbeiten. Die interne Kommunikation im Unternehmen erfolgt auf Englisch, daher sind gute Englischkenntnisse erforderlich, um effektiv mit unseren internationalen Teams zu kommunizieren – Perfektion ist jedoch nicht notwendig. Da du eng mit Zahnarztpraxen in Deutschland arbeitest, setzen wir muttersprachliches Deutsch voraus.

Diese Rolle ist kundenorientiert und erfordert eine proaktive, eigenverantwortliche Persönlichkeit mit hervorragenden Organisationsfähigkeiten und Freude am Kund:innenkontakt. In einem dynamischen Startup-Umfeld übernimmst du Verantwortung und bringst eigenständig technische Lösungen auf den Weg. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren IT-, Engineering- und Sales-Teams zusammen, um Roger zu einem unverzichtbaren Werkzeug für Dentalprofis zu machen.

Aufgaben

  1. Koordination der Software-Installation: Organisiere und koordiniere die Remote-Installation einer lokalen Komponente in Zahnarztpraxen über TeamViewer. Arbeite dabei eng mit der IT der Praxis und unserem internen IT-Team zusammen.
  2. Durchführung der Installation: Führe die Installation der Software-Komponente eigenständig durch und stelle sicher, dass alle Systeme korrekt miteinander verbunden sind.
  3. Einrichtung von Kommunikationskanälen: Konfiguriere und richte Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp für die Nutzung in der Praxis ein, um eine optimale Kommunikation mit Patient:innen zu ermöglichen.
  4. Unterstützung im Onboarding-Prozess: Stelle sicher, dass die Software optimal auf die Bedürfnisse der Praxis abgestimmt ist und unterstütze das Praxisteam bei Fragen und der Einarbeitung.
  5. Kund:innenbetreuung und -kommunikation: Pflege eine enge und professionelle Kommunikation mit den Praxen, sei erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für technische Fragen und begleite die Kund:innen während der gesamten Implementierungsphase.
  6. Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams: Arbeite eng mit den Sales-, Support- und Engineering-Teams zusammen, um technische Lösungen zu liefern und die Implementierung optimal abzustimmen.
  7. Management der internen IT: Unterstütze das interne IT-Management und stelle sicher, dass alle IT-Ressourcen effektiv genutzt werden.

Bonus-Aufgaben

Personaldisponent Rail (m/w/d)

Du verantwortest die operative und perspektivisch standortübergreifende Personaldisposition für den Bereich Rail und sorgst für eine verlässliche Besetzung aller Dienste und Schichten. Dabei planst, steuerst und optimierst du den Personaleinsatz unter Berücksichtigung von Qualifikationen, Urlauben, Krankheitsfällen und weiteren Abwesenheiten.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Digitalisierung von Planungs- und Dispositionsprozessen. Du begleitest die Einführung einer neuen Bahnsoftware und trägst dazu bei, bestehende Prozesse zukunftsfähig und digital aufzustellen.

Mehr als Disposition: Du gestaltest die Zukunft der Personalsteuerung im Rail-Bereich aktiv mit. Freu dich auf viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Verantwortung und die Chance, nachhaltig etwas zu bewegen.

Eine spannende und verantwortungsvolle Position in einem dynamischen Dienstleistungsbereich sowie eine leistungs- und marktgerechte Vergütung und moderne Sozialleistungen (wie z. B. 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenwirksame Leistungen, Maßnahmen zur betrieblichen Gesundheitsförderung, betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung und vieles mehr).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at accilium Group GmbH
description_html:
accilium is an award-winning strategy and management consultancy shaping the future of mobility and energy. We work with industry leaders in Automotive & Transport, Energy & Environment, and Public & Infrastructure. Founded in 2017, we've grown to 110+ people across seven offices Berlin, Munich, Vienna, Cologne, Hamburg, Bucharest, and recently Warsaw. Our subsidiary &amp (50+ developers) lets us deliver end-to-end. We've been ranked Top 10 in the brand eins/Statista "Best Consultants" list five years running and were awarded "Hidden Champion 2026/2027".

The role

As Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x), you work with our clients to turn breakthroughs in AI technology and research into production systems. Working at the intersection of bleeding edge technologies and the transformation of leading enterprises' core value chains, you will drive the organizational transformation to intelligent systems and help our clients re-architect work. You will also drive Project aIQ - accilium's transformation into an AI-native company and help us ship weekly builds of our organization “accilium OS”.

In this role, you will join our Technology Practice to build the foundation for a team of Forward Deployed Engineers.

What you will build

  • Build agentic systems and embed them in our clients' value chains to realize efficiencies as well as top line growth

  • Deliver technical artifacts like agents, MCP servers and agent skills that will be used in production workflows.

  • Develop and codify build and deployment patterns and contribute these assets to accilium as well as the open-source community.

  • Continuously maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks.

  • Embed closely and build strong relationships with our clients' teams and proactively spot opportunities for AI deployment throughout the lifecycle of an engagement.

  • Expand on accilium’s build capabilities for agentic systems and deploy solutions for our internal value chains

What we offer

  • 61k gross annual (all-in) for graduates, 82k gross annual (all-in) with 2 years relevant full-time working experience

  • Open-door culture, flat hierarchies, latest tech kit

  • Frontier-model API access funded, no token budget gating on experimentation

  • Standard amenities: Public transport ticket, corporate benefits, team events (reTreat, acc'sPerience, acc'smas Party), up to 1 day per week home office


What you bring

  • University degree, ideally with exposure to AI, mathematics, physics, or software engineering, data science

  • Optional: 2-3 years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Strong track record based on actual build products (GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of systems you've shipped)

  • Process-design instinct and hands-on experience with analytical, generative and agentic AI stack (agent harnesses, context engineering, skills)

  • Deep understanding of how model behavior affects enterprise outcomes

  • Ability to operate autonomously and thrive under ambiguity as well as under pressure

  • Ambition to move fast and take risks

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, problem-solving and interpersonal skills

  • German and English at C1+ level*

  • Willingness to travel to build on-site with our clients 1–3 days/week in DACH

*Global scale - Table 1 (CEFR 3.3): Common Reference levels (coe.int)

accilium is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Full-Stack-Entwickler:in (Gn) In Dortmund - Keine Überstunden
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at EXWE GmbH
description_html:
Entwickle Software, die wirklich genutzt wird.

Bei EXWE - Experts in Webtechnologies - entwickelst du individuelle Web- und E-Commerce-Lösungen, die Unternehmen digital voranbringen. Wir glauben: Großartige Software entsteht, wenn Menschen mit Leidenschaft, Kreativität und klarem Kopf arbeiten, nicht durch Überstunden.

Dein Platz bei EXWE

Bei uns triffst du auf ein buntes Team aus mehr als 15 Entwickler:innen, Projektmanager:innen und Kreativen, alle voller Energie und Ideen und stets mit dem Anspruch, die besten digitalen Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Für uns zählt das „Wir“: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam, übernehmen Verantwortung füreinander und begegnen uns offen, respektvoll und neugierig. Wir wollen uns selbst, im Team und als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln. Das motiviert uns, Neues zu schaffen und aus Erfahrungen zu lernen.

Wenn dich IT begeistert und du bereits erste Kenntnisse mitbringst, die du motiviert und neugierig weiterentwickeln möchtest, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Das erwartet Dich

  • Arbeitszeit & Flexibilität: Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) mit flexiblem Start bis 9.45 Uhr
  • Vergütung: Jahresgehalt 45.000 – 55.000 € je nach Erfahrung + Bonuszahlungen, wenn wir gemeinsam erfolgreich sind
  • Flexibles hybrides Arbeiten: Ein modernes Büro mit charmantem Altbauflair direkt am Tremoniapark in Dortmund plus die Flexibilität von zwei Homeoffice-Tagen pro Woche
  • Freizeit & Erholung: 29 Tage Urlaub und minimaler Reiseanteil

Aufgaben

Wo du wirklich etwas bewegst

  • Du arbeitest von Anfang an aktiv an der technischen Umsetzung spannender Software- und E-Commerce-Projekte mit, vom ersten Konzept bis zum Go-live
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund*innen und dem Projektteam und bringst deine Ideen und technischen Lösungen ein
  • Du entwickelst sauberen und performanten Code im Front- und Backend und arbeitest dabei mit modernen Technologien
  • Du liebst es, neue Features zu testen, und auch mit der anschließenden Doku kommst du klar
  • Du hilfst dabei, Kundenbedürfnisse und technische Lösungen sinnvoll mit den jeweiligen Business-Zielen zu verbinden
  • Du behältst Qualität, Budget und Timing im Blick und organisierst Aufgaben im Projekt.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Entwickler*innen zusammen und hast die Möglichkeit, dein Wissen kontinuierlich auszubauen und zunehmend Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Du unterstützt Junior Softwareentwickler*innen bei fachlichen Fragen und kannst dein Wissen im Team weitergeben

Qualifikation

Was Dich auszeichnet

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt und fühlst dich in der Full-Stack-Entwicklung wohl
  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse in Symfony, Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, MySQL

Du erfüllst nicht alle Kenntnisse? Kein Problem, für uns zählt deine Leidenschaft und der Wille dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du hast Freude daran, individuelle Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln und dich in die Anforderungen unserer Kund*innen hineinzudenken
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und hast Lust, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln
  • Du bist eine echte Teamperson und bringst fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit

Benefits

On top für Dich

Work-Life-Balance & Gesundheit

  • Keine Überstunden: Wir achten auf gesunde Arbeitszeiten
  • Fühl Dich wohl: HanseFit-Mitgliedschaft, Bonusversicherung, monatliche Check-Ins oder professionelle mentale Unterstützung durch Auntie. Du suchst aus, was Dir guttut.
  • Bis zu 2 Wochen Workation pro Jahr EU-weit
  • Bringe Deinen vierbeinigen Kollegen gerne mit und sorge für gute Laune im Team

Weiterbildung & Entwicklung

  • Individuelles Fortbildungskonzept nach Deinen Bedürfnissen
  • Mentoring und Wissensaustausch im Team
  • Regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche mit Deinem direkten Ansprechpartner im Team

Team & Events

  • Gemeinsame Events: Ob Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest, Kiosk-Tour oder Pen-and-Paper-Abend. Wir setzen auf Teamgeist auch abseits des Büroalltags

Zentrale Lage & Mobilität:

  • Gute ÖPNV-Anbindung, Parkplätze direkt vor der Tür und ein Zuschuss zum Deutschland-Ticket
  • Bike-Leasing für nachhaltige Mobilität

Kein Benefit, sondern Basics mit Liebe: Snacks, Drinks und eine top ausgestattete Küche stehen immer für Dich parat.

Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Schick uns Deine Unterlagen (CV, kurzes Anschreiben, optional Portfolio) ganz einfach über das Bewerbungsformular. Wir melden uns innerhalb von drei Tagen bei Dir
  • Erstes Gespräch (30 Minuten): Gegenseitiges Kennenlernen und erster Eindruck.
  • Zweites Gespräch (45 Minuten): Fachlich vertiefendes Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Entscheidung: Du erhältst unsere Entscheidung innerhalb einer Woche
  • Vertragsgespräch: Gemeinsam besprechen wir den Vertrag und klären alle offenen Fragen, und dann heißt es “Willkommen TEAM“

Wenn Du Lust hast, morgens mit guter Laune ins Büro zu kommen, freut sich Meike schon auf Deine Bewerbung!

title: Werkstudent Accounting (w/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Natsana GmbH
description_html:
Über uns

Hey, wir sind natsana. 
Und bei uns geht es um mehr als nur Nahrungsergänzung – wir arbeiten jeden Tag daran, Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden für Millionen Menschen einfacher zugänglich zu machen und Produkte zu entwickeln, die einen positiven Einfluss auf die Lebensqualität haben.
 
Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leidenschaft, Qualitätsbewusstsein und Innovationsgeist etwas zu bewegen, dann könntest du perfekt in unser Team der natsana Allstars passen. Wir suchen nach Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen wollen, die mitdenken, mitgestalten und zusammen mit uns weiter wachsen möchten.
 
Gemeinsam bewegen wir mehr.
Unter unserem Dach vereinen wir mit natural elements, Nature Love, gloryfeel und Feel Natural vier der erfolgreichsten und wachstumsstärksten Marken im Bereich hochwertiger Nahrungsergänzung. Seit 2025 begleitet uns die Bayer AG als starker Partner. Gemeinsam sind wir ein echtes Powerhouse für Qualität, Innovation und nachhaltiges Wachstum.
Wir entwickeln Produkte, die Gesundheit und Lebensfreude fördern – natürlich, wissenschaftlich fundiert und mit einem sehr hohen Qualitätsanspruch. Gleichzeitig feilen wir aber auch weiter an einer Unternehmenskultur, in der Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und echtes Miteinander zählen. 
Deine Ideen sind willkommen. Dein Impact ist sichtbar. Dein Einsatz macht den Unterschied.
Kommst du an Bord?


Warum wir?

Weil wir mit viel Energie, klarer Ambition und einer guten Portion Teamgeist wachsen – und dabei niemals vergessen, wie wichtig Wertschätzung, Offenheit und transparente Kommunikation sind. Denn bei uns zählt nicht nur das Ergebnis, sondern auch jedes kleine Zwischenziel und das Miteinander auf dem Weg dorthin.
 
08/15? Passt nicht zu uns. Wir suchen Mitgestalter:innen, die mit 100% Herzblut dabei sind, neugierig bleiben, den Status Quo hinterfragen und Verantwortung übernehmen. Teamplayer mit Haltung, Drive und eigenen Ideen, die etwas bewegen möchten.
Wenn du Lust hast, dich bei den natsana Allstars persönlich und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln, einen Impact zu haben und Teil eines spannenden Teams zu sein, dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf, von dir zu hören und dich in einem persönlichen Gespräch kennenzulernen.


Und jetzt konkret. Bei uns geht’s gerade um:

Werkstudent Accounting (w/m/d)
Anstellung: Teilzeit, auf Stundenbasis, bis zu 20 Std./Woche, flexible Arbeitszeiten
Direkter Vorgesetzter: Director Finance Controlling
Team: Accounting
Einsatzort: Im Büro in Hamburg oder Düsseldorf, im Homeoffice


Deine Aufgaben

Du interessierst dich für Rechnungswesen und möchtest praktische Einblicke in die Buchhaltung eines wachsenden Unternehmens gewinnen? Dann unterstütze unser Finance-Team dabei, Buchhaltungsprozesse effizient und digital am Laufen zu halten.

  • Unterstützung bei der Vorkontierung von Eingangs- und Ausgangsrechnungen
  • Mithilfe bei der Pflege von Kreditoren- und Debitorenstammdaten
  • Unterstützung bei Rechnungsläufen über digitale Freigabetools (Candis)
  • Mitarbeit bei einfachen Auswertungen und Reportings in Excel
  • Unterstützung bei der Digitalisierung und Ablage von Buchhaltungsbelegen
  • Punktuelle Unterstützung bei Vorbereitungsarbeiten zum Monatsabschluss (z. B. Belegzuordnung, Datenabgleich)


Dein Profil

  • Studierende:r der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Interesse an Rechnungswesen.
  •  Erste praktische Berührungspunkte mit Buchhaltung (z. B. durch Praktikum oder Ausbildung) sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. 
  • Strukturierte, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise sowie sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
 
Bei natsana testen wir gerne neue Technologien und denken Arbeit immer wieder neu. Aktuell begeistert uns KI in allen Bereichen - wenn dich das Thema interessiert und du offen bist, Neues auszuprobieren, freuen wir uns auf dich. Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber vor allem zählen Neugier und Lernbereitschaft.


Was wir dir bieten

Damit du einen kleinen Vorgeschmack bekommst, was dich bei uns abseits der Arbeit erwartet, haben wir dir die natsana Allstars-Vorteile mal auf einen Blick zusammengestellt:
 
Flexibles Arbeiten & Erholung: 

  • 30 bezahlte Urlaubstage, flexibel in Absprache gestaltbar
  • Zusätzliche freie Tage: Flex Day, Weihnachten & Silvester
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten ohne feste Kernzeiten, angepasst an dein Leben
  • Hybrides Arbeiten bis zu 100 % mobil, mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch in unseren Offices in Hamburg und Düsseldorf
  • Workation: Bis zu 120 Tage innerhalb der EU, für kürzere Zeiträume auch außerhalb der EU nach individueller Absprache
 
Ausstattung & Arbeitsumfeld:
  • Top-Equipment (MacOS oder Windows)
  • Umfangreiche Ausstattung fürs mobile Arbeiten inklusive Bezuschussungen
  • Moderne Offices im Herzen von Hamburg & Düsseldorf mit sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung, Parkmöglichkeiten und attraktiver Infrastruktur
  • Voll ausgestattete Küchen, in Düsseldorf zusätzlich Massagesessel & eigenes Gym – kostenlos für dich
 
Kultur, Impact & Entwicklung: 
  • Company-Events mehrmals im Jahr
  • Allstar-Kultur: Deine Meinung zählt, dein Beitrag macht Impact
  • Faires Bonussystem, das Leistung und Engagement widerspiegelt
  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung mit klaren Karrierepfaden, kompetenzbasierten Feedback-Runden sowie Kursen, Konferenzen & Büchern – wir investieren in dich und deinen nächsten Schritt
 
Benefits & Extras:
  • Individuell wählbare Benefits über become.1 (z.B. Zuschüsse für KiTA, Internet, Mobility) & weitere Programme
  • Weitere Extras wie Corporate Benefits, Urban Sports, betriebliche Altersvorsorge u.v.m.
  • Freie Kleiderwahl – bei uns gibt’s keinen Dresscode, sei einfach du selbst


Deine Bewerbung

Du möchtest Teil unserer Reise und der natsana Allstars werden?
Dann schick uns einfach eine Bewerbung, die zu dir passt!
 
Im nächsten Schritt lernen wir uns in einem Videocall oder persönlich in unserem Office kennen.
Wir freuen uns auf dich!
Dein natsana Team

title: AI Transformation Manager (f/m/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Merantix Momentum
description_html:
What we do

AI is redefining how companies compete. Most organizations know they need to transform but only few know how to realize it. As AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you are the person who bridges that gap: turning strategic ambition into lasting organizational change.

Merantix Momentum is developing the next generation of impact-driven AI. As a Berlin-based startup, we are driving enterprise AI transformations across industries by building and deploying B2B solutions, orchestrating scaled, AI-native operations. We work across several domains including automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and others, transforming businesses through ML using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning. Our start-up DNA defines the way we drive rapid value creation with a humble, diverse, and hungry team.


Your role

As an AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you bring deep domain and consulting experience to lead clients through end-to-end AI transformation, from identifying strategic opportunities to driving organizational and technical change at scale. You are equally comfortable leading a focused 6-week engagement with a 500-person Mittelstand manufacturer as well as a multi-phase transformation with a large enterprise. You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives.

You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum’s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals.

Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. You are fluent in modern AI trends and applied technology and you can educate, challenge, and influence stakeholders with credibility and confidence.

You don't just advise on AI: you understand how it truly works. You are fluent in modern AI capabilities and can explain how AI capabilities, products, and bespoke Machine Learning solutions are built. This allows you to credibly champion solutions, evaluate investment choices, navigate technical trade-offs, and convince key stakeholders of AI's transformative value.

Your main responsibilities will include the following:

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer the end-to-end execution of AI transformation engagements — from first lighthouse use case to company-wide rollout. Find the internal champions, manage the blockers, build multi-threaded stakeholder relationships, and drive measurable adoption and organizational change.

  • Support Key Account Growth: Convert pipeline opportunities into growing account relationships and multi-layered transformation programs with the Sales team; support pre-sales, proposal writing, and key-account expansion with an entrepreneurial mindset.
